notes.title: Update 1.9.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/292b14028e6938544d1900dcf9812f39123bba38.png[/img]

New Season

The new season has already begun! All players’ mines went to the bots and their levels dropped. Your task is to take them back, level them up, and defend them from other players’ attacks! And, when the season is over, the bravest and most courageous defenders will receive chevrons reflecting the valor they have shown on the battlefields

Battle Reward Changes 

We have made the process of obtaining high-level chests, such as legendary and mythic ones, Let’s scale new heights, Defenders! :) 
To find more information about the battle rewards, look for a dedicated post on our social media. 

New Heroes in the Castle

A squad of new Heroes has arrived at the Castle. They are determined to raise your level even higher. Give them a chance to prove themselves and they will not let you down! 

U’uk (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic monkey king designed to significantly increase the damage dealt to the underground Creeps in the Castle.
Troublemaker (and its foil counterpart) is an epic beast warrior hunting down the underground Creeps of legendary rarity and below. 
Fallen (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic knight whose mind has been consumed by the shadow. His specialization is to inflict fear on his enemies. 
Minstrel (and its foil counterpart) is an epic musician whose songs breathe a new life into and give them vivific energy totems. 
Dragon Warrior (and its foil counterpart) is an epic warrior who has spent years learning martial arts. People say that with one hit he can stun his opponent ‘til the end of their days. 

New Cards

Flying Shredder is a unique mythic tower one sight of which makes the Creeps shudder with fear. It is flying, and inflicts a Hemorrhage effect on the enemies that deals damage over time.

As usual, the new tower will be available in one of the following events. 

New Enemies

“The Primezone is bigger than we’ve thought,” concluded Primologist on his briefing with the Hero squad. He has cautiously warned the warriors about new Creeps that have been spotted on the east of the Primezone. 

Scatheless Spider is a small but capable enemy that cannot be poisoned. You have to find other ways to fight this pest :) 

Adamantine Goliath is an enemy with a nasty surprise: upon death, it releases a horde of Scatheless Spiders. Arachnophobes, beware!

New Totem

When nature itself makes you follow a completely different set of rules, druids call it silence. We present you a new Totem. 
Cancelling Totem prohibits the use of magic in a certain area around it. 

Fixes

- Fixed the bug with quests related to the Pumpkin Gun and Volcano towers that did not finish;
- Fixed the bug with Corruption crafting when the players might have received the wrong number of shards;
- Fixed the bug with the Crystal Teleport when the players could place the runes on them blocking the path for flying/underground enemies;
- Fixed the bug with Flicker not enhance Burning Roots;
- Fixed the bug with the Queen and Incandescent Core not dealing the correct amount of damage to the flying enemies;
- Fixed the bug with the Indestructible Idol not dealing the increased amount of damage to the Fleetles when they were underground;
- Fixed the bug with the foil Mermaid’s Tower not stunning the Fleetles when they were underground;
- Fixed the bug with enemies not receiving the stunning effect under the Magma spell.

notes.title: Thematic event! 🌞
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/2c350e9b5f3bc75114a234d256b5867f62397fec.png[/img]


Defenders!

Defenders, attention! An unusual place was discovered in Defenders 2 charged with solar energy! Keep the universe balance, defeat the Creeps, and get valuable prizes for that ːsteamhappyː

Defeat the attacks of the Creeps on a special location, get Sun Stones as a reward, and exchange it for valuable prizes in a special Sun Market!

To get to the location, tap the button with the Sun stone logo on the right side of the screen.


[h3]1. Special Location[/h3]
To battle in this special place, the brave Defenders need special Energy. The Energy restores once a day or can be bought for Stars. Active Premium doubles the amount of Energy!
Clearing the hard levels does not require additional energy. It means the more hard levels you clear the more Sun Stones you get!


[h3]2. Victories and Sun Stones ːsteamhappyː[/h3]
For every victory (even on the hard levels) you will get Sun Stones as a reward.
Exchange it for valuable prizes in a special Sun Market

The number of Sun Stones per battle will be increased when the location level reaches: 90, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500.


[h3]3. Valuable Prizes[/h3]
Among the prizes, in the Sun Market you may find:

🌞 New collectible runes with improved effects - including an increased number of tower upgrades in battle!
🌞 Special Shadow card shards for crafting, 
🌞 Lots of regular runes with double or triple effects, 
🌞 Card shards, including the foi ones;
🌞 And lots of resources!


[h3]4. Location Level[/h3]
Location level may be increased by clearing hard levels:

🌞 clearing 1–10 hard levels will not change the location level
🌞 11 cleared levels will increase location level by 1
🌞 12 cleared levels will increase location level by 2
🌞 13 cleared levels will increase location level by 3
etc.
The maximum location level increase that can be obtained in one battle is 10. You may get it after clearing 20 hard levels.

The number of Sun Stones per battle will be increased when the location level reaches: 90, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500.
The active Premium doubles the number of Sun Stones you get as a battle reward!

The location level, that is raised by the number of battles, changes daily according to the following rules:

If the location level is below 90 → nothing changes
Level 90 to 124 → goes down by 10
Level 125 to 149 → goes down by 15
Level 150 to 169 → goes down by 20
Level 170 to 199 → goes down by 25
Level 200 to 224 → goes down by 30
Level 225 to 249 → goes down by 35
Level 250 to 274 → goes down by 40
Level 275 to 299 → goes down by 45
Level 300 to 324 → goes down by 50
Level 325 to 349 → goes down by 60
Level 350 to 374 → goes down by 70
Level 375 to 399 → goes down by 80
Level 400 to 424 → goes down by 90
Level 425 to 449 → goes down by 100
Level 450 to 474 → goes down by 110
Level 475 to 499 → goes down by 120
Level 500 and more → goes down by 130


[h3]5. Premium[/h3]
The active Premium gives you a couple of bonuses simultaneously:

🌞 Twice as much required Energy;
🌞 Twice as much Sun Stones as battle rewards;
🌞 and four special offers at the Sun Market!


[h3]6. Rating[/h3]
The most active Defenders can fight for top places in the rating!

For their daily successes in repelling the attacks of the naughty monster, the brave Defenders receive points of "solar" rating. The daily “increase” in the rating is the figure of the achieved level of the mine.

After the event is over, the players who have got top places will receive an additional reward!

🏆 1st–3rd places: Mythic Amulet of sun power chevron!
🏆 4th–10th places: Legendary Amulet of sun heat chevron!
🏆 11th–100th places: Epic Amulet of sunbeams chevron!

These chevrons will not give you an edge in battles but they will add a thematic icon to your nick in chat! ːsteamhappyː

🌞 Lots of regular runes with double or triple effects,

🌞 And lots of resources!

notes.title: Update 1.9.11
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/1df62d7b4ae12b51a3912831580c365b2ad920c4.png[/img]


[h3]New Season[/h3]
New Season has already begun! All players’ mines went to the bots and their level dropped. Your task is to get the mines back, level them up, and defend them against other players’ attacks!
With introduction of the new resource mines we have added a new shevron that you can get for your rating achievements during the Season.


[h3]Themed Event: Sun Battles[/h3]
Defenders, attention! A special place was discovered in Defenders 2, charged with solar energy! Maintain the balance of the universe, fight off the Creeps' attacks, and receive valuable prizes. To get to the location, tap the button with the Sun Stone symbol on the right side of the screen.

Look for more information in the related posts on our social networks ːsteamhappyː


[h3]New Heroes for the Castle[/h3]
You heard the dull sound of the cartwheels. A carriage with another squad of new Heroes has arrived at the Castle. They are sprightly and ready to conquer new peaks. Hurry up and recruit the new warriors:

🔹[b]Grenadier[/b] (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic professional shooter of the Damage group;
🔹[b]Firemaster[/b] (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic fox mage of the Inflammation group;
🔹[b]Tamer [/b](and its foil counterpart) is a mythic warrior and tamer of the Against Flying group;
🔹[b]Muse[/b] (and its foil counterpart) is an energetic mythic Hero of the Totems and Energy group.


[h3]New Heroes of the Teleportation Group[/h3]
We are thrilled to see you taking control of the Prime Zone matter and using portals. That is why we are giving you more reasons to make the Teleportation a permanent card in your deck! Here for you:

🔹[b]Techna[/b] is an epic Hero whose powers increase the chance and distance of the teleportation;
🔹[b]Electra[/b] (and its foil counterpart) is a mythic Hero that not only increases the chance and distance of the teleportation but gives additional bonuses to the Towers and spells;

Now, there is also a foil counterpart of the Teleportation card in the game.


[h3]Meet Invincibug, a New Enemy[/h3]
They say that when the Prime Zone was formed, this bug’s body absorbed an unimaginable amount of Prime, making its skin stronger than the toughest diamond.

The new enemy not only flies but is also completely immune to any poison. The bug's skin is so tough that the immunity to poison cannot be removed even by the Purifier or Tower of Order. Get ready to use all your ingenuity to fight back this monster!


[h3]A New Spell[/h3]
A new spell is here! Corruption is a mythical spell that curses enemies in a similar way as the existing legendary card. However, for flying enemies, this card is much more dangerous, because this curse’s effect is 1.4 times stronger on them!
As usual, the card will be available in one of the following events.


[h3]Balance Changes ⚙️[/h3]
⚙️ The Banshee Tower. Now, Banshee, as befits a harbinger of death, uses all her horror to instill fear in the Creeps. The Creeps' Fear Chance and Immunity base values ​​are now similar to other mythic Towers. Banshee still casts a curse, but this effect is secondary, and Tower upgrades now increase the duration and power of fear.

⚙️ The Volcano and Pumpkin Gun. We are making changes to the mechanics of inflicting damage by the "puddles" of these Towers, as in some cases they worked incorrectly.
Now, only one "puddle" from one Tower will inflict damage in each tile of the playing field. Several "puddles" from one Tower will inflict damage only if they are located in different areas of the playing field.
At the same time, several "puddles" from several towers will summarize their damage even at one area of the playing field.
Simply put, before the damage was bound to a "puddle", now, it is bound to the Tower. Therefore, it still makes sense to have as many Towers of this type as possible in order to maximize the overall damage.


[h3]Improvements 🔧[/h3]
Make it a good habit to check your in-game mailbox on time ːsteamhappyː
Now, all letters in the "Other" folder have a retention period. After this time, the letter will be deleted.

Don't miss important correspondence, Defenders!

[h3]
Fixes 🛠 [/h3]
🛠  Fixed a bug that prevented the creation of the foil Fortune Tower;
🛠  Fixed a bug with Audrey who could be taken on the same ship as Katana;
🛠  Fixed a bug with Duelist who could be taken on the same ship as Bruiser;
🛠  Fixed a bug with the Burning Roots that could not be placed in the Creeps' path.

notes.title: Castle! New Features!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/95115faa543d81c38cb406541373fed40b2a7577.png[/img]



Defenders!

Our curious Audrey has found a secret wing in the Castle with a number of rooms overgrown with cobwebs in it... full of treasures and the Creeps, of course! Are you ready to challenge the ancient monsters, continuing your thorny path through the ancient Castle?

To fight the Creeps that you have unwittingly pulled out of their monster sleep you will need some help. The catalysts' discovery helped summon a squad of new fighters, who will gladly join your team and help you in your fight for the Castle. They will also be useful for your daily affairs in the Prime Zone.


[b]Reinforcement & Repair[/b]
Tinta, epic Hero
Watercolor, mythic Hero

[b]Curse
Soul Catcher, epic Hero (outside the Castle his duties were delegated to Moira whom you can find in your decks instead of Soul Catcher)[/b]
Shadow of Death, legendary Hero
Psychopomp, mythic Hero

[b]Poison[/b]
Shinigami, epic Hero
Vendetta, mythic Hero

[b]Against the flying enemies[/b]
Jaeger, epic Hero [b](outside the Castle his duties were delegated to Archer whom you can find in your decks instead of Jaeger)[/b]

[b]Damage[/b]
Hunter, epic Hero

[b]Area Damage
Quarrier, epic Hero (outside the Castle his duties were delegated to Tyke whom you can find in your decks instead of Quarrier)[/b]
Steamrock, legendary Hero

[b]Incineration[/b]
Spark, epic Hero
Flicker, legendary Hero

[b]⚠️ Please note:[/b]

❕  All Heroes mentioned above have a foil version; 

❕  Epic and legendary Heroes are active only inside the Castle, but can be hired to the ship with other Heroes of the same group that are also active outside the Castle;

❕  Mythic Heroes are active both inside and outside the Castle. All bonus parameters that the towers receive from them are much higher inside the Castle.


[h3]Secret Chambers[/h3]

As for the secret chambers full of treasures ... Now, after clearing a level of the Castle, with a certain chance bonus levels where you can battle will appear. They are more difficult than the same levels of the Castle, but the reward is worth it! Your efforts will be rewarded in full.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/9d6b1070c607c39b30ad4597ddd24feae0409323.png[/img]


Still getting used to the Castle?! The time has come! After clearing the bonus level, you can also get foil card shards! That being said, in most cases, you will see collectible foil shards as a reward!

How do you like that, Audrey?


[h3]Distinctive Features of the Bonus Levels[/h3]

🔅  In addition to the general rules of playing in the Castle, at the bonus level, you cannot use the cards with which you won the last battle;

🔅  The difficulty of the bonus level can be lowered in exchange for Stars. It will not reduce your reward, but the Creeps will be noticeably “lighter” at the level;

🔅  Clearing the bonus level does NOT require energy. Try as much as you like. The attempt fee is a certain amount of Silver.


[h3]What to do in this case? Let us tell you:[/h3]

🔸 Move through the Castle by using other towers to unlock the set of cards you will need to clear the bonus level;

🔸 In this update, we have added a Replay button to the Castle. Replay the current level with other towers to find your own way to clear the bonus level.


Defenders, put your best foot forward and conquer the ancient Castle! May the luck be with you in your battles!

notes.title: STORY QUESTS!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/fedb8fe0ad53d39c10a66d1b4794866938fd62ee.png[/img]


Defenders! 

The new update is just around the corner, and we are preparing a number of goodies that you will have a chance to enjoy in the near future!
Now, we would like to tell you about a new feature that never was a part of Defenders 2 before ːsteamhappyː

[h3]STORY QUESTS![/h3]

You have written to us that the quests in their current form are not really interesting for various reasons, especially because of the reward in the form of keys. Well, you asked for it, you got it! We have listened to you and redesigned this tab completely, so that it will be fun for players of ALL levels.

And in the next update, we will present completely updated quests. There will be a series of story quests with some cool rewards for their completion. You can kill two birds with one stone: learn more about the universe of Prime World: Defenders 2 and receive some valuable prizes, among which there are valuable resources, chests of up to [b]mythical[/b] rarity, [b]shadow shards[/b], and much more!

Well, what kind of story is it if it does not have a prologue? Do not worry. We are thrilled to share with you the opening comic of Defenders 2, which kicks off the story-driven quest in the game!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/6d99d4fb83b2286c2883354ee8cc8af856f274c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4408ae042df49ede324cab422005b0d6960031e3.png[/img]


[h3]Let’s reveal some details here[/h3]

After installing update 1.9.10, you will see the "Quests" tab in story quests. Several special quests will be available to you. To complete these quests, you will need cards that meet the requirements.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d840e96a32d8e89012036441c41f3aee6f3241be.png[/img]


Also, right away you will be able to see the reward you will receive for completion of the quest, the time it takes to complete it, and the cost of launching it.
And the icing on the cake: each quest includes a plot fragment of the world of Defenders 2's history ːsteamhappyː


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b69b06bbdc2f0985963f45dae5c78d801b5916eb.png[/img]


[h3]What else is there to know?[/h3]

🔹 Having a [b]Premium[/b] will double the rewards received.
🔹 You can speed up the quest's progress by paying a certain number of stars.

[b]Please note[/b] that this is just the beginning of a big storyline. New quests will be added to the game on a regular basis, providing you a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the amazing world of Prime World: Defenders 2, as well as rewarding you handsomely for completing the quests.

Well, off you go to the next great adventure in the world of Prime World: Defenders 2 ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.9.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/72cd18354754c25af69c4c83ffe013b7513e704d.png[/img]


[h3]Story Quests[/h3]
We are happy to present you with completely revamped quests. There will be a series of story quests with some cool rewards for their completion!
By completing the quests, you can kill two birds with one stone: learn more about the world of Prime World: Defenders 2 and receive some valuable prizes, among which there are valuable resources, chests of up to mythical rarity, shadow shards, and much more! Learn more about the new story quests on our social networks. 

Well, what kind of story is it if it does not have a prologue? New players can now enjoy an amazing storyline comic at the start of the game. Our experienced Defenders are also not left behind: the comic is already available on all our social networks!


[h3]What’s New with the Castle?[/h3]
While the Castle has been standing still and proud, its development has not. Meet new bonus levels where you can battle and receive foil card shards and other valuable prizes as a reward!

And what about new Heroes? Well, here they come! The catalysts' discovery helped summon a squad of new fighters, who will gladly join your team and help you in your fight for the Castle. They will also be useful for your daily affairs in the Prime Zone. You can meet them at the Castle's Trading area.


[h3]Teleportation: Introducing the New Game Mechanic.[/h3]
Here and there in a blink of an eye! Meet a completely new game mechanic designed to make the gameplay even more immersive!

Before going into details, we would like to note that in the next game updates we will expand the line of such cards! Now let's welcome the first cards with the new mechanics:

[b]Crystal Teleport[/b] is a legendary tower that moves the Creeps a few tiles back. Just like the stun/fear, the teleport has a chance to be triggered, and the Creeps gradually gain immunity to this effect.
[b]Teleportation[/b] is a mythical spell that, at your command, will move the Creeps in the selected area to a farther distance.

Isn't it cool?

As usual, you will be able to get the new cards at one of the following events.


[h3]Rebalances[/h3]

[b]Burning Roots[/b]. The burning turned out to be not powerful enough, so we hastened to fix it. The tower now deals more damage and slows down the Creeps even more.

We also introduce a foil version of the [b]Burning Roots[/b]. This tower deals double damage to the underground Creeps.

[b]Flying Smasher[/b]. The card upgrades now increase the stun chance.
Moreover, now you can insert runes to increase the stun chance, and the Heroes who have the same effect will strengthen the tower. Not enough? Anomalies and Speed runes now increase the stone fire rate.

[b]Snowball[/b] has undergone treatment similar to the Smasher. Card upgrades increase the chance of slowing down. You can also insert runes to increase the chance of slowing down, and Heroes who have the same effect will strengthen the tower. Anomalies and ​​Speed runes increase the snowball fire rate.

[b]Tower of Order[/b]. Well, the name speaks for itself. Now, similar to the Purifier, it removes buffs (even immunities!) from the Creeps, but now it is an AREA effect! It no longer slows down the Creeps.
The foil version of this card further increases the duration of the silence effect.

[b]Meteor[/b]. We have listened to your requests! From now on, runes for the main parameter increase the stun duration (we have not forgotten about battle improvements ).
THE CREEPS WILL NOT PASS.
The foil version of the card now additionally increases the stun duration!

[b]Queen[/b]. This card was not a real match for its royal name in various game situations. We have made some changes to it, so now the card will become a welcome addition to your deck. Now, the tower increases damage to flying enemies by 4 times!


[h3]Improvements[/h3]
➕ We are making some visual changes! We have updated the icon for the mythical chest. It now reflects the value and importance of this magnificent chest.
➕ Please note that from now on, after trying to impose the fear effect on Gnolls, Wolfhounds, and Magi, the slowing effects cease to act on them.

notes.title: The Castle!

tags.feature: The Castle is available for players who have reached level 3. You can get there by using one the following ways: by clicking on it on the map of the Prime Zone or by clicking a special button on the right side of the screen.
There are no difficult levels inside the Castle and starting the battle is free. However, for the loss or escaping the battle you will have to pay with 1 Energy;

You can place and upgrade the towers only before the battle begins. The amount of Prime at the beginning of the battle is increased according to the player’s level, with Castle chevrons, and by taking special Heroes with you: Witch Doctor, Sorceress (and her foil counterpart), and Hellblade;
You have 10 Life Points in the Castle and this number cannot be increased;
The map of the Castle remains unchanged and no events (totems, anomalies, disasters, etc.) ever happen there.

The Castle gives you a precious resource over time, regalia. Regalia can be exchanged for valuable goods in the Trading area. The higher is the level of your Castle the more regalia it will give and the more valuable goods will appear on the shelves;
Besides, for each completed stage of the Castle, you will receive additional guaranteed rewards.

notes.title: Update 1.9.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/9cea95e50f07b5cd7421b7a5a44e1429a0697559.png[/img]


Defenders! 

Great news: we have fixed the bug with rating discrepancies in resource mines; prepared the whole new Castle for you with its unique Heroes, distinctive features, and rewards; and there is a new mythic tower, Burning Roots.

[h3]Mines[/h3]

We express our gratitude to all the players who reported the bugs to us and provided us with additional information. All bugs have been fixed now. We would like to remind you that the current season has been extended until May 3.

🔧 Fixed a bug with the rating number that did not match the sum of resource mines' levels. Now all the calculations must be correct.
[i]
[b]Please note[/b]: in order for the changes to take effect, you must have at least one battle in each resource mine.[/i]

🔧 Fixed bugs that could lead to a situation when after the battle in the resource mine the buttons "Attack" and "Change Opponent" would not appear.

[h3]Castle[/h3]

We present you the place that every Defender needs. A real home, a well-equipped base in the heart of the Prime Zone - [b]the ancient Castle[/b] is all of the above!

Fight in exciting battles, level up your Castle, and get a special resource, regalia. The Castle merchants will gladly exchange them for a variety of valuable goods, from essential resources to special Heroes! The higher is the level of the Castle, the more regalia you will receive and the more valuable goods will appear in the Trading area ːsteamhappyː

There are two ways to get to the Castle: by selecting it on the Prime Zone map or by clicking on a special button on the right side of the screen.

[h3]New Heroes[/h3]

The first squad of unique Heroes has arrived at the Castle, and you will be able to hire them right after you install the update. They will be available for hiring in the new unique Castle store called Trading area.

[b]Witch Doctor[/b] is a Hero that increases the amount of Prime at the beginning of a battle in the Castle.

[b]Sorceress [/b](and her foil counterpart) is a legendary Heroine that increases the amount of Prime at the beginning of a battle in the Castle.

[b]Hellblade[/b] is a mythic assassin from the ancient clan that increases the amount of Prime at the beginning of a battle both in and out of the Castle. This Hero cannot be hired with Fanatic and Sorceress at the same time.

[h3]New Tower[/h3]

[b]Burning Roots[/b] is a mythic tower of the Inflammation group. It extends burning branches that slow down all the Creeps nearby and set them aflame. It works on the underground Creeps as well.

New tower, as usual, will be available in one of the upcoming events.

notes.title: Space battle!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddab712bc20ef454f9bc3434925dc49ac6e85c2e.png[/img]


Defenders, attention! 

An unusual place was discovered in Defenders 2 charged with cosmic energy! Keep the cosmic balance, defeat the Creeps, and get valuable prizes for that ːsteamhappyː

Defeat the attacks of the Creeps on a special location, get Rocket fuel as a reward, and exchange it for valuable prizes in a special Space Market!

To get to the location, tap the button with the Rocket logo on the right side of the screen 🚀

[h3]1. Special Location[/h3]
To battle in this special place, the brave Defenders need special Energy. The Energy restores once a day or can be bought for Stars⭐️ 
Active Premium doubles the amount of Energy!
Clearing the hard levels does not require additional energy. It means the more hard levels you clear the more Rocket fuel you get!

[h3]2. Victories and Rocket fuel ːsteamhappyː[/h3]
For every victory (even on the hard levels) you will get Rocket fuel as a reward.
Exchange it for valuable prizes in a special Space Market!

The number of Rocket fuel per battle will be increased when the location level reaches: 90, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500.

[h3]3. Valuable Prizes[/h3]
Among the prizes, in the Space Market you may find:

🎁 New collectible runes with improved effects - including an increased number of tower upgrades in battle!
🎁 Special Shadow card shards for crafting, 
🎁 Lots of regular runes with double or triple effects, 
🎁 Card shards, including the foi ones;
🎁 And lots of resources!

[h3]4. Location Level[/h3]
Location level may be increased by clearing hard levels:

🔹 clearing 1–10 hard levels will not change the location level
🔹 11 cleared levels will increase location level by 1
🔹 12 cleared levels will increase location level by 2
🔹 13 cleared levels will increase location level by 3
etc.
The maximum location level increase that can be obtained in one battle is 10. You may get it after clearing 20 hard levels.

The number of Rocket fuel per battle will be increased when the location level reaches: 90, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500.
The active Premium doubles the number of Rocket fuel you get as a battle reward!

The location level, that is raised by the number of battles, changes daily according to the following rules:
If the location level is below 90 → nothing changes
Level 90 to 124 → goes down by 10
Level 125 to 149 → goes down by 15
Level 150 to 169 → goes down by 20
Level 170 to 199 → goes down by 25
Level 200 to 224 → goes down by 30
Level 225 to 249 → goes down by 35
Level 250 to 274 → goes down by 40
Level 275 to 299 → goes down by 45
Level 300 to 324 → goes down by 50
Level 325 to 349 → goes down by 60
Level 350 to 374 → goes down by 70
Level 375 to 399 → goes down by 80
Level 400 to 424 → goes down by 90
Level 425 to 449 → goes down by 100
Level 450 to 474 → goes down by 110
Level 475 to 499 → goes down by 120
Level 500 and more → goes down by 130

[h3]5. Premium[/h3]
The active Premium gives you a couple of bonuses simultaneously:

💥 Twice as much required Energy;
💥 Twice as much Rocket fuel as battle rewards
💥 and four special offers at the Space Market!

[h3]6. Rating[/h3]
The most active Defenders can fight for top places in the rating!

For their daily successes in repelling the attacks of the naughty monster, the brave Defenders receive points of "space" rating. The daily “increase” in the rating is the figure of the achieved level of the mine.

After the event is over, the players who have got top places will receive an additional reward!

🏆 1st–3rd places: Mythic Conqueror of the Galaxies chevron!
🏆 4th–10th places: Legendary Star-Bender chevron!
🏆 11th–100th places: Epic Galactic Trailblazer chevron!

These chevrons will not give you an edge in battles but they will add a thematic icon to your nick in chat! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/43a4abb6d600060cbd78f3696dbed88321881528.png[/img]


Defenders!

As you know, our game is actively developing and evolving. We are adding new functions and cards, reworking old mechanics. These changes are often global and may affect the entire game.
At the same time, some functions become less relevant and do not correspond to the current situation in the Prime Zone anymore.

That is why we have revised a number of game aspects in the version 1.9.7 to make them match better with the game’s complexity and fun.

[h3]1. Difficult Level Changes.[/h3] 
Let us remind you that Difficult level is a more difficult battle on the same map, with already built and / or upgraded towers, which you can try to clear if the current battle is completed with the maximum number of hearts. Clearing a certain number of difficult levels increases the rewards value that you will receive after the battle.

Along with the introduction of a new mine system, we have also improved the Difficult levels system. However, we have not introduced them immediately, along with the test launch of the mines.

⚙️  Previously, the number of Difficult levels available for clearing increased very slowly, opening completely (up to 20) only at level 60 of your account.
This late availability hindered low and intermediate level players, especially when they started to fight for the mines.

Now, the maximum number of Difficult levels is available for clearing as soon as you reach level 35 of your account. Accordingly, players of lower levels will be able to fight the Creeps for bigger rewards, and with other players for high-level mines.

⚙️  The difficulty increase was non-linear: at first it increased slightly, and the main increase occurred already towards the high levels. This situation led to the situation when some battles, especially the ones in the mines, did not pose a real challenge to the player and did not reflect well the competitive aspect of the game.
Therefore, we have changed the formula for increasing difficulty: now it rises faster, which makes Difficult levels (especially in the PvP mode) more interesting, and battles more intense. At the same time, the maximum level is still the same, 20, i.e. maximum difficulty has not changed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a62ea74cf3cf994d44714e4c726c408bd6c7fcbe.png[/img]


⚙️  Also, getting the improved battle reward, especially in the highest level mines, was easy. Before, when the fight in a high-level mine was time-limited, it was justified. However, in the new system, the reward distribution has become incorrect.
At the same time, the absence of a reward for completing the maximum level 20 for players with a Premium raised some questions.

And along with the end of the new resource mine system test period, we have made the planned changes to the rewards. Now the improved reward demands the higher number of Difficult levels cleared.
And premium account owners can compete for an additional reward, which becomes available after passing the most difficult level 20!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/76eb13d86a60929edca8b75dbd1ec3f46dd6a71a.png[/img]


We have also revised the rarity of cards received as a battle reward, relative to the point level (PvE or PvP battles). Now its rise is smoother.

[h3]2. Changes in the cost of starting a battle on PvP and PvE locations.[/h3]
Taking into account the fact that players now always receive resources without any downtime caused by inability to capture the mine and / or the change unavailability of changing the opponent, the cost of starting a battle has been revised.
We did not make these changes during the new mine system test launch, and we are adding it now, along with some improvements, at the start of the new season.

Now the cost of starting a battle is:

⚪️  In regular PvE missions - from 110 to 1,505 Silver (depending on the point level)
⚪️  In epic PvE missions - from 110 to 5,000 silver (depending on the point level)
⚪️  In legendary PvE missions - from 110 to 10,015 silver (depending on the point level)
⚪️  In resource mines - the cost of launching depends on the mine level.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8db950b1f48c800227f628c5eff6674041b7f017.png[/img]


Of course, when dealing with resource mines we did not ignore their league counterparts. Now, players can find Shadow shards for crafting and leveling up the necessary cards in the chests they get for the league competition!

[h3]3. Changes in the cost of mythical cards crafting and level-up.[/h3]
Taking into account the fact that with the new resource mines system the process of obtaining Red Crystals from the Red Chests has become much more controllable, we have adjusted the cost of creating and leveling up the most valuable towers in the game — mythical ones.
Besides, Red Crystals had been losing their relevance as a valuable resource necessary to obtain and upgrade the "red" content which also led to misunderstanding among the players.
Now Red Crystals will become much more understandable and valuable for all players: both those who have recently reached level 90, and those who have already settled at the top of the game!

Now the cost is:

♦️  2 Red Crystals for creating 1 shard of a mythic tower card or spell
♦️  1,500 Red Crystals for the evolution of a tower, spell, or Hero card.

[h3]4. In-game Store.[/h3]
Also, we have made some improvements to the in-game store in this update.
The Random tab has been renamed to Fair and got a new icon that reflects its essence better!
Besides, we have significantly expanded and updated the assortment in this tab, so it would be interesting to players of all levels. We have also updated some of the offers in the Calendar tab. You can now find Shadow shards and essences among them.

See you in the Prime Zone!

notes.title: Update1.9.7!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ea765aea70386d8e1fe24d6cabeca843ff889b72.png[/img]


[h2]New Season[/h2]
New Season, the first one after we reworked resource mine mechanics, has already begun! All players’ mines went to the bots and their level dropped. Your task is to get the mines back, level them up, and defend them against other players’ attacks!
With introduction of the new resource mines we have added a new shevron that you can get for your rating achievements during the Season.

[h2]Resource Mines[/h2]
We have fixed a couple of bugs in the new resource mine system and added some enhancements to make the mines more convenient and easy-to-understand for all players.

🛠  The Attack button has returned to the Information window;
🛠  We have fixed the bug with opponent’s disappearance after losing battle for the mine;
🛠  We have fixed the bug with the situation when a mine would occasionally freeze in the searching for opponent state after your victory;
🛠  We have fixed the bug with incorrect Revenge time.

[h2]Economy Rework[/h2]
Due to the active game development, in version 1.9.7 we have revised a significant number of game aspects: difficult levels, chest rarity in battle rewards, the cost of starting a battle, the cost of upgrading and crafting mythic cards, and much more. These system elements have been redesigned to better fit the overall game logic in general and the new mine system in particular.
For more information check our accounts on social networks.

[h2]In-game Store[/h2]
The Random tab has been renamed to Fair and got a new icon that reflects its essence better ːsteamhappyː
Also, we have significantly expanded and updated the assortment in this tab, so it would be interesting to players of all levels. Besides, there are additional slots with special offers available for purchase only for those with a Premium.
We have also updated some of the offers in the Calendar tab.

[h2]Spells[/h2]
Spells have become more effective and easy-to-understand for players of all levels ːsteamhappyː

🔮  Spell effects have been revised and now they increase the most effective parameters for each card individually;
🔮  Now, the Effectiveness parameter does not increase the spell’s damage over time as it works with towers;
🔮  We have fixed the bug with the situation when the in-battle parameter upgrade would not increase the spell parameters;
🔮  We have fixed the visual bug with the before battle map description that would show incorrect parameters.

[h2]Chat[/h2]
Now you can share any card in the chat! To do this, open the card menu and press the Chat button. Other players can tap on the card's name in the chat to see its parameters.

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
Welcome the new cards to the game! As usual, you will be able to get them in the following events.

[b]Chance Tower (and its foil counterpart)[/b]
[*] This mythic tower increases the chance of triggering effects for all allied towers nearby.

[b]God’s Punishment (and its foil counterpart)[/b]
[*] The new mythic spell is here! It deals damage and stuns up enemies for some time. 

[b]Demonologist (and its foil counterpart)[/b]
[*] A new (but familiar :) ) legendary Hero that increases the number of friendly anomalies in battle to 5 (the foil one — to 6). [/list]

[h2]Rebalances[/h2]
⚙️  Pied Piper of Level 1 now increases the experience gain by 25%. Experience gain increase for the fully leveled up Hero has not changed.
⚙️  Audrey of Level 1 now increases the amount of Silver gained as a battle reward by 25%. Silver gain increase for the fully leveled up Hero has not changed.

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
🛠  Now you can get the following cards from the chests: Cleansing, Sky Burner, Sniper Rifle, Tornado Generator, Incandescent Core, and Fanatic.
🛠  To complete the tasks with Fog Tower now you have to kill the enemies who are under its effect.
🛠  Ghost Tower and Spirit Tower are in the Damage group now;

notes.title: New mines: questions and answers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8bdf3839007bb95178acd4d4e49e2300d6fa5e9b.png[/img]

Defenders!

As you already know, we introduced the new resource mine system into the game in February :) As of now, the system is in the testing mode. We are watching closely at how it works in the Prime Zone and by the start of the new season we are planning to add something new to it.
And of course we are following the players’ response to the system and what is still unclear to them.

So, today we have prepared some answers to the frequently asked questions about the new mine system!

[b]1. How does the change work? I’m pressing the button but the mine just won’t change![/b]
In the new system the only thing that changes is your opponent. The mines under your ownership do not change.

[b]2. Why doesn’t the mine level up after the change?[/b]
In the new system, in order to get a higher level mine, you need to take it from your opponent. The mine level does not change on its own.
And the "Change" button changes only the opponent, but not the mine in their possession.

[b]3. Why does my mine have a lower level than it had yesterday?[/b]
It means that another player attacked your mine and successfully captured it. 
After the capture you got their mine of a lower level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/27f918ea84d6fe5e8741c9d493a6d54f8961df8c.png[/img]

[b]4. How do I level up my mine?[/b]
There are two ways to do this:
- If the mine has already been leveled up but was taken from you, you can use revenge. This way you can reclaim the highest level mine you owned at this point. Please note: revenge is only available for 24 hours after your mine was captured!
- Attack opponents. Since the system is looking for the opponents whose mine level is always higher than yours, by capturing their mines, you get a mine of a higher level.

[b]5. Player A has taken my mine but my revenge is on Player B! How did it happen?[/b]
The target of your revenge is not the player but the mine. If Player A has left the mine (probably by capturing another one), then your revenge will not be on them.

[b]6. I have lost 2,500 points of rating on one of my mines in one day and my level has dropped from 400 to 150! How did it happen?[/b]
Several players have captured the mine, one after another, which is why such a drop happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/51f16e818cf9a649f922853ef2da4d13d74bc7b1.png[/img]

At the same time, it is not hard to get it all back — just use revenge — and your mine will once again be of Level 400.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a15c2d63894bea3f8b8fa32d6e2510bfa14f6c27.png[/img]

[b]7. I had an opponent of Level 200. My mine was taken away from me and it became Level 90. Hasn't the opponent changed too? Can I capture a mine 100 levels higher?[/b]
Yes, that is right. For some time, the opponent, who was picked up at a high level of the mine, will be available for attack.
If you use Change, the system will find an opponent closer to the current mine level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/fefaa4b215c59260ea1b421b31954c0d0509d4be.png[/img]

[b]8. What is the “Retreat” button for?[/b]
You can use it if the mine is owned by a start bot (at the start of the season, for example).
It allows you to lower the mine level. We did it for the players to have an opportunity of making things easier, in case the current mine is too tough for him.
The decrease in the level follows the Seasonal Rules:
- Mines of up to Level 100 - level does not change
- Mines of Level 101-200 - level drops to Level 100
- Mines of Level 201 and above - level drops to (current mine level * 0.7). However, it cannot get below Level 201.

See you in the Prime Zone!

notes.title: Lunar Holiday!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/2543d6593730f5c8f7f1fcc26c734156a8aa5a42.png[/img]


Defenders, attention! 


An unusual place was discovered in Defenders 2 that was lit and blessed by the moon itself! Keep the balance, defeat the Creeps, and get valuable prizes for that ːsteamhappyː

Defeat the attacks of the Creeps on a special location, get Lucky Coins as a reward, and exchange them for valuable prizes in a special Lunar Store!

To get to the location, tap the button with the Yin-Yang logo on the right side of the screen.

[h3]1. Special Location[/h3]
To battle in this special place, the brave Defenders need special Energy. The Energy restores once a day or can bought for Stars. Active Premium doubles the amount of Energy!
Clearing the hard levels does not require additional energy. It means the more hard levels you clear the more Lucky Coins you get!

[h3]2. Victories and Lucky Coins ːsteamhappyː[/h3]
For every victory (even on the hard levels) you will get Lucky Coins as a reward.
Exchange them for valuable prizes in a special Lunar Fair!

The number of Lucky Coins per battle will be increased when the location level reaches: 90, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500.

[h3]3. Valuable Prizes[/h3]
Among the prizes, in the Lunar Fair you may find:

🎁  Collectible runes with enhanced effects! This set differs from the Halloween and Holiday runes ːsteamhappyː
🎁  Special Shadow card shards for crafting, 
🎁  Lots of regular runes with double or triple effects, 
🎁  Card shards, including the foi ones;
🎁  And lots of resources!


[h3]4. Location Level[/h3]
Location level may be increased by clearing hard levels:

[*] clearing 1–10 hard levels will not change the location level
[*] 11 cleared levels will increase location level by 1
[*] 12 cleared levels will increase location level by 2
[*] 13 cleared levels will increase location level by 3
etc. [/list]
the maximum location level increase that can obtained in one battle is 10. You may get it after clearing 20 hard levels.

The number of Lucky Coins per battle will be increased when the location level reaches: 90, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500.
The active Premium doubles the number of Lucky Coins you get as a battle reward!

The location level, that is raised by the number of battles, changes daily according to the following rules:

Level 90 to 124 ➡ goes down by 10

Level 400 to 424 ➡ goes down by 90

Level 475 to 499 ➡ goes down by 120

[h3]5. Premium[/h3]
The active Premium gives you a couple of bonuses simultaneously:

🎉 Twice as much required Energy;

After the event is over, the players who have got top places will receive an additional reward!

🏆 1st–3rd places: Mythic Yin Yang chevron!
🏆 4th–10th places: Legendary Yin Yang chevron!
🏆 11th–100th places: Epic Yin Yang chevron!

These chevrons will not give you an edge in battles but they will add a thematic icon to your nick in chat! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New mine system!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8bdf3839007bb95178acd4d4e49e2300d6fa5e9b.png[/img]


Defenders!

Meet the all new resource mine system in Prime Zone!

[h3]1. Getting Resources[/h3]

[i]Now, at any point, every player will have their own mine that will give them resources. If the player's opponent captures their mine, the player will still get the resources because they will receive their opponent's "old" mine.[/i]

So, the player will always receive the resources without losing their mine in order to get a higher position in the rating. Besides, this system eliminates unpleasant situations, when the player of low or medium levels cannot capture a mine and is left without resources for leveling-up.

[h3]2. Opponent[/h3]

[i]The enemy is the player who currently owns a mine that you can attack.[/i]

An important difference from the current system is that matchmaking now selects a specific mine for attack, not a specific player. The mine available for attack will always be of a higher level than the current one.

One mine can be chosen as an attack target only for one player.

Before the attack, you can see your opponent’s nickname, mine level, set of monsters, disasters, etc. If, for some reason, you do not want to have a battle on the proposed conditions, you can look for another opponent and, of course, another mine.

[h3]3. Searching for an Opponent[/h3]

[i]You can search for a new opponent at any point of time now. Besides, the search does not take your current mine away, and the new mine for attack is ALWAYS of a higher level than your current mine. [/i]

Now you can look for a new opponent at any time (without having to wait 48 hours after the last battle in the mine).

Each search costs a certain amount of resources:

🔸 0 Silver
🔸 1,000 Silver
🔸 5,000 Silver
🔸 25,000 Silver
🔸 50,000 Silver
🔸 100,000 Silver
🔸 20 Stars
🔸 30 Stars
🔸 40 Stars
🔸 50 Stars
🔸 and then each search will cost 50 Stars

[quote] 📌 Please note:

❕  Increased cost of finding a new enemy is for all mines. For example, searching for an opponent in the Poison Mine will raise the cost of searching in the Air Mine, etc.

❕  The search price is reset to the minimum value once a day, at 5 a.m. (UTC +3).[/quote]
[i]At the same time, after each successful battle the system will automatically choose a new opponent for you.[/i]

[h3]4. Revenge[/h3]

[i]Revenge is a retaliatory attack on a mine that was in your possession but captured by the opponent now.[/i]

Revenge has several limitations:

🔸 Revenge is available for 24 hours after the mine has been captured by your opponent. After this time, it is not be possible to recapture the mine;

🔸 Even if there are a lot of enemies and they are advancing, constantly capturing the mine, the highest-level mine that you owned before the defeat will be chosen for revenge;

🔸 Revenge becomes unavailable for any victory at this point, even if it was a battle with the opponent.

Thanks to these changes, there will no longer be situations where the change mine option would lead to large drops in the rating and mine level. And the player will have the opportunity to reclaim the lost mine and get back the rating points lost after a successful opponent’s attack.

[h3]5. Rating[/h3]

[i]In the new PvP system, the rating became clearer. It is the sum of levels of all the mines that you own right now[/i]

Accordingly, to increase the rating by 100 points, you need to level-up the mines by 100 levels in total.
Moreover, if the mine is conquered by the opponent, your rating will be decreased by the difference in the levels of the former and current mines.

[h3]6. Seasonal Reset[/h3]

[i]Along with the start of the Season, all mines, as per tradition, will go to special bots, and their level will be decreased.[/i]

The level drop occurs according to the following rules:

🔸 Mines of up to Level 100 - level does not change
🔸 Mines of Level 101-200 - level drops to Level 100
🔸 Mines of Level 201 and above - level drops to (current mine level * 0.7). However, it cannot get below Level 201.

See you soon!

notes.title: Update 1.9.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/df5f8106581a91e428c8e141139cc1861a1bac4c.png[/img]


Defenders!

The maintenance is over, Prime Zone welcomes you back!

[h2]New Mine System[/h2]
The completely revamped mine system is here! 

It will let you have a constant inflow of resources, look for new opponents more often and choose the one you “like” the most out of them, and will make the rating system clearer ːsteamhappyː

Look for more information about the new mine system in our social network profiles.


[h2]New Tower[/h2]
There is a new mythic card in the game, Laser Tower (and its foil counterpart).
This Tower’s attacks combine single target damage and area damage, burning right through the Creeps with a laser beam. Players can control the Tower’s aim during the battle by directing the laser beam. The Tower does not seek the enemies automatically.

You may get Laser Tower, as usual, in one of the following events. Don’t miss out on it ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Per your requests we have added an ability to sell All-Purpose Gears, Spell Amplifiers, Ice Emblems, and Blessed Hammers. To do this you need to open the big map and tap on “Sell” in the pull down menu.

[h2]Rebalances[/h2]
Fixed the bug with rune indicators that increase Chance parameter multiplied among themselves instead of adding-up.

Along with this fix, we have revised the base chance of inflicting an effect and % of accumulated resistance for some towers:

🔹 For Mermaid’s Tower (and its foil version), the base stun chance is now 150%, the Creeps get 5% resistance;

🔹 For Flaming Cannon, the base chance of stunning is now 150% (and 200% for the foil version), the Creeps get 10% resistance;

🔹 For Horrifying Tower, the base chance of inflicting fear is now 100% (135% for the foil version), the Creeps get 10% resistance;

🔹 For League Shiny Crest, the base chance of inflicting fear is now 135%, the Creeps get 10% resistance;

🔹 For the foil version of Flying Crusher, the base stun chance is now 150%, the Creeps get 5% resistance;

🔹 For Christmas Tree, the base chance of inflicting fear is now 50% (60% for the foil version), the Creeps get 5% resistance;

🔹 For Festival Mortar, the base stun chance is now 100% (and 120% for the foil version), the Creeps get 5% resistance.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
🛠 We have switched off the tasks on killing the Creeps with Support Towers (Engineering Tower, Repairing Tower);

🛠 Wild Rider and Night Queen cannot be hired at the same time;

🛠 We have fixed a visual bug with Sky Eye’s missiles.

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
Completing “Assault” PvE-missions (green swords) in some cases doesn’t add to the Battle Pass progress. When such location is renewed (either in time or for stars) its progress adds up correctly.

notes.title: Update 1.9.4!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/70903880d3b25cc4a585cb429dd56834bb239e35.png[/img]


Defenders!

The version 1.9.4 is here.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/65d36033729e9264bfb7956d3612bfd48ef5c6d7.png[/img]


[h1]Chat[/h1]

You have asked to introduce some new features into the game chat, and we have listened ːsteamhappyː

🔹 Now you can see account level next to player’s nick;
🔹 Tapping on the player’s nick will copy it and paste it automatically into the text field;
🔹 Upon receiving foil version of a card you will see an asterisk before the card’s name;
🔹 If the player gets two or more same cards in a row, they will receive only one technical notification;
🔹 Tapping on the card’s name in the chat will let you see its full description and appearance;
🔹 Your own message will no longer be shown as a notification on the chat indicator on the global map.


[h1]New Cards[/h1]

Meet Bruiser, a new Hero in the Prime Zone! He is a legendary counterpart of a well-known players’ favourite Hero, Duelist ːsteamhappyː

Also, there are foil versions of the following cards: Flying Crusher, Missile Launcher, Bruiser, Patriot, and Lady Frost.
As with the other foil cards you have a chance to get them while crafting ːsteamhappyː


[h1]Anomaly Towers[/h1]

Now, there is a chance for an Anomaly Tower to appear on the battlefield.
This is a special Tower that will help you fight specific enemies in a battle. However, it is damaged at the beginning of the battle and requires some amoun of Prime.

📌 [b]Please note:[/b] these anomalies do not receive bonuses from Demonologist and Night Queen.


[h1]New Enemies [/h1]

If your account is of Level 90 you may encounter new enemies on the battlefields — fearless warriors of the wolf pack!

🔹 Gnoll. When trying to inflict Fear on this small and fast monster, he clears himself of all debuffs and increases his speed by 200%. 

🔹 Werewolf is a ground monster with average health and speed parameters. When trying to inflict Fear on him, he clears himself of all debuffs and increases his speed by 200%. 

🔹 Wolfhound. He is slow, has plenty of health and strong armor parameter. He also clears himself of all debuffs and increases his speed by 200% when trying to inflict Fear on him.


[h1]Runes[/h1]

🔹 Endurance Rune now increases effectiveness and health parameters of the Tower (instead of main parameter and Tower’s ability power);

🔹 Strengthen Rune now increases the Tower’s toughness by 45-50% (instead of 45-75%)

🔹 Longevity Rune now increases the Tower’s toughness by 45-70% (instead of 45-75%)

🔹 Runes that increase the Tower’s main parameter now add main damage and damage per second to the Towers with periodic damage. 

🔹 Now damage and damage over time for the Towers with periodic damage is increased with the damage parameter instead of the effectiveness. Because of that you cannot place runes that increase effectiveness on the Towers with periodic damage (Hornet Hive, Volcano, Colony of Bats, etc.).


[h1]Rebalances[/h1]

🔹 Now Pumpkin Tower’s (and its foil counterpart’s) projectiles curse enemies instead of slowing them down.

🔹 Damage of Missile Launcher has been increased.


[h1]Fixes[/h1]

🔹 Fixed the bug with Fleetles not being stunned by Meteor while underground.

🔹 Fixed the bug with the foil Tu’Rehu when upgrading him by 6 or 8 helmets increased an incorrect amount of parameters.

🔹 Fixed the bug with Missile Launcher that in some cases could destroy allied Towers.

🔹 Fixed the visual bug when the player could see the card that they would get from the chest in the chest preview.

🔹 Fixed the visual bug when foil Dealy Prime Tower did not show graphic effects of a buff from Prime Injector and Aim Tower.

notes.title: Secrets of witchcraft!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/24ba30281bca0c547616194faa403ef61f26db8f.png[/img]


Defenders!

There is a saying that autumn is a  season of witches. While ordinary people lay a store of fruits and vegetables for the winter, Vixen has as much fun as she can. She enchants zeppelins, puts spells on Harpies, or plays a game of tag with Slothcat — so much fun!

However, as Vixen said, to do something grand, you need Tarot cards. 

[h2]Secrets of witchcraft![/h2]

You can get many valuable rewards:
🔥 Lots of Towers, from epic to mythic ones, including the foil Towers;
🔥 Lots of Heroes, including the foil ones;
🔥 New Towers — Flying Crusher and Missile Launcher (for players of Level 60 or above);
🔥 Valuable resources, including Hero tokens and Red Crystals for players of Level 90;
🔥 And much more!

💥 Level 90 players can get Red Crystals and mythic card shards (including the foil ones)!

You can get Tarot cards:

[b]Via in-game methods[/b] 🎮 (get twice more cards by activating Premium):
🔹 as a reward for each battle (including completing difficult levels);
🔹 opening chests located on the map.

[b]Via other ways:[/b]
🔹 watching ads (on mobile devices);
🔹 purchases with stars (3000 cards for 100 Stars).

The event will last until 30.11.
🕒 23:59 UTC 29.11 is the last minute you can get Tarot cards via in-game methods. Tarot cards you’ve already collected will be stored on your account for 24 hours.
🕒 Until 23:59 UTC 30.11, you will be able to use remaining cards to spin the wheel.
🕒 After that, cards will disappear from your account

Find out all the Secrets of witchcraft!

notes.title: Update 1.9.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4a8ef0e9c84c1855f167fbb5d378e2926d69118f.png[/img]


Defenders!

[b]The version 1.9.3[/b] is here.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/aed2da763993b8e942f4e33e8e8597456067438f.png[/img]

Welcome a new system in the game — rune crafting system!

By using it you can create any rune of your choice: with double or triple effects, special event ones (for example, from the Halloween set of pumpkin runes or a triple rune for the central slot). The only condition is that you have [b]at least one such rune[/b] in your collection. 

The system itself is similar to the Tower, Spell, and Hero crafting systems:

[*] You should choose a rune that you want to create from the inventory. For crafting you need to have at least one such rune of any rarity in your inventory;
[*] And proceed to the rune crafting interface by tapping a special button.

In the interface you can see:

[*] What rune was picked for crafting;
[*] Progress Bar: you will make crafting available the first time you fill the bar to 100%. However, the rune you are creating will have a minimal rarity (for example, epic rarity in case of double runes and legendary for Retribution Rune). The more times you fill the progress bar, the rarer rune you will get, up to the cyan one.

If the progress bar is not completely filled the shown % indicates your chance of getting an [b]additional[/b] rune of higher rarity.

Rune crafting requires some Silver and stones. The cost will increase accordingly the rarer the rune you are creating. 
Besides, creating runes with double and triple effects, and event runes will increase the cost of crafting and requirements for how much your progress bar is filled. 

You can use any runes for crafting. The rarer the rune you use for crafting the more % of progress bar it will fill. 
However, the number of rune effects (one, two or three) will not help you fill the progress bar faster.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/6aafbde6fd46290bac7f4e033688e09fc36d3d71.png[/img]

To make buying at the Random Shop more understandable and be in control of it, we have changed its assortment renewal rules.

[*] Now, you can renew the assortment of goods only by tapping the Update button; 
[*] Free renewals are given every three hours and you can get the maximum of three (as it is now).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/6e25d7c3fae5ffca127833e03121afebe1ed87b5.png[/img]

Welcome her on the battlefields, Iron Fury! This flying enemy is protected by armor and you can encounter her if your account has reached Level 90.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e83d585869b60f822d17a9420c72ce5a915815bf.png[/img]

There are two new mythic towers in the game — Flying Crusher and Missile Launcher.

Flying Crusher deals area damage, affecting both ground and underground enemies. 
And flies away then ːsteamhappyː

Missile Launcher is similar to the well-known Mortars and seals additional damage to the bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/05f3b356fbda0b299895158ee822050f220f3455.png[/img]

Shaman invited his closest sibling to the Prime Zone, foil Shaman ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b26218670530284bee2b9c19cc9e2630186904d3.png[/img]

[*] Basic range of Aim Tower is 2.5 now (instead of 2) 
[*] Basic range of foil Aim Tower is 3 now (instead of 2.5) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/cc25e77029e4b852182bdbe4a7e12a16a82e9312.png[/img]

[*] Fixed the bug with curses when effects from different sources did not sum up;

[*] Fixed the bug with graphical effect from Aim Tower might not appear on the Towers standing on the edge of its range.[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.9.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8186867ebd18322c1af221d928e3989578528033.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/bb98213e05e6a5cf2ec70d69d33fe68cfb581f99.png[/img]
Attention Defenders! We found a place with very high otherworld activity in Defenders 2! They say there is really spooky fun going on there...

Defeat the attacks of the Creeps on a special location, get pumpkins as a reward, and exchange them for valuable prizes in a special Dreadful Store!

And get the main event reward — special themed runes!
These are Tower runes with upgraded double and triple effects and a dreadful pumpkin on the icon :)

You can find out more about the new runes and the rules of the event in special post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b335bdce8b933f1ff519be81685d8c7117c60d98.png[/img]

Besides, among the sweet prizes you may find Shadow shards of the legendary Towers, Spells, and Heroes in the Dreadful Store. You will not be able to create a card with them but they can be used for crafting and/or card upgrades :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/67549ad4eff839f03866999ff80a393a6a9a1f42.png[/img]

Foil versions of Golden Dust Barrier, Fire Rain, Wendigo, and Pumpkster are in the game now.

The maximum number of upgrades (on cyan rarity) is five now.  

[*] Barrier Rune now doubles the amount of additional damage to the Tower — 40-70%. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f08115075cc3cc357477fef839327648ca0a1fd2.png[/img]

[*] Rewards for completing assignments have been changed: The number of obtained helmets is 20, 60 and 120 per star now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a49c6f03b0476f4369facdd4bb817fb6cc922187.png[/img]

[*] Fixed an incorrect damage increase when leveling-up Flying Saucer;

 🔹 as a reward for each battle (including completing difficult levels);

notes.title: Update 1.9.1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e4f272d9571f6bf9d7e34761db7de4f3d052dd1d.png[/img]

Defenders!

[b]The update 1.9.1[/b] has been installed. The Prime Zone is waiting for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/6fda1002b08d16d7957c5ba55fd20a0e3369d79d.png[/img]

To make the process of getting cards more transparent, understandable, and uniform, we have decided to get rid of the Hero chests.

[*] Now, the regular chests that you can receive as a battle reward or buy at the store can get you cards, Heroes shards, and all types of Hero tokens.

[*]  We have removed Hero chests from the game.

[quote] [b]Please note![/b] You cannot get new Heroes — who appeared in the game with the last update — as well as the Heroes of the Servants and Brisk groups from the chests.[/quote]

The rarity of Heroes and tokens, dropping from the chests, will be determined according to the current system, which means the whole process of getting Heroes will become much easier, including those of the legendary rarity ːsteamhappyː
And, of course, you no longer have to spend tokens on Hero chests because you will only need them for evolution and craft.

[*]  Now you can get mythic chests as a battle reward (both in PvP and in PvE high-level locations)

[*] Besides, the red chests now contain not only card shards but also silver, resources, and legendary runes (including those with a double effect)

[*] At the same time, you can buy red chests at the store for both Red Crystals and Stars.

[quote] [b]Please note![/b] In the future, the purchase of mythic chests for Red Crystals will be disabled.[/quote]

It means that level 90 players will be able to receive mythic chests more often, and collecting runes of high rarity will become easier. After all, legendary runes will be in the red chests! And also valuable runes with a double effect ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/57b0409ec9a0dd52dcb84f7ff5db43efdb65844c.png[/img]

Now, you can get Hero tokens as a reward for a completed task. Silver ones if your account is of Level 30 or above and Golden ones if it is of Level 70 or above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a8d47a96a5822038af4648873f1bb4cb0b6522cf.png[/img]

Defenders 2 introduces a completely new system: the creation of specific player-selected Tower, Spell, or Hero card shards.
Now you can use the accumulated shards to create the cards that you need!

[b]To do this, you need to follow the instruction:[/b]
[*] Select the card or card shard from those available in the collection;
[*] Use a special button in the card menu that will take you directly to the crafting interface;
[*] Select which cards from the inventory you would like to convert to the ones you have selected at the first stage.

Besides, by doing this, you get a chance of receiving a bonus — shards of card's foil analog or other special cards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/2dec535e8bf38c87df656e43f2cef84ac3ea4cd2.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/da2cf31d990be736340b5d09d329b8c172e39895.png[/img]

Thus, you will have full control of getting the cards you need and/or their duplicates (to increase the Quantity parameter, for example). And receive foil counterparts of your favorite cards ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f795be002d77988c95c288033d661dd11ed7ded6.png[/img]

A new enemy has appeared in the Prime Zone, Fleetle! You can meet it in any location if your account is of Level 90.

This flying enemy is extremely cunning: when trying to land, it burrows under the ground, removing all debuffs from itself, and continues its way there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/eb21d7c846212b4a5ceb290e632ed07886cb178a.png[/img]

[*]  Now, when choosing Heroes for a team (in the ship interface), you can see special icons indicating that the Hero belongs to a particular group.

[*]  Also, you can now sort Heroes by groups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e040b94ea3ff545b57d5cc9b387f70cc7f21598e.png[/img]

[*] Added the function for an early automatic release of the Creep waves. Hooray! ːsteamhappyː

[*]  Added the duration of magic display in-battle. It is a special icon with a countdown timer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d76af4c49a5641d53a9e8a05382ea036aa103233.png[/img]

The evolution cost for cards of mythic rarity has been changed.

[*] The new cost of the evolution of red Towers and Spells is 150 Red Crystals, 20,000 essences of one type, and 10,000 essences of another.

[*] Evolution of the red Hero costs 150 Red Crystals + 4,500 silver helmets + 2,250 golden helmets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4d41c027ebf72ea975a2a7f419f3774bbc5bbf99.png[/img]

[*] Added foil counterparts for many cards:
[list] [*] Towers: Incombustible Blackthorn, Flying Saucer, Incandescent Core, Christmas Tree, Festival Mortar, Petard Mortar, Minigun, Reviving Tower, Snowball, The Queen, Ghost Tower, Banshee Tower, Colony of Bats.

[*] Spells: Merciless Strike, Time Warp, Golden Dust Barrier, Poisonous Swamp.

[*]Heroes: Banshee, Vampire, Da'Ka, Defender, Nosferatu, Tu'Rehu, Snow Maiden, Mage, Vixen, Squink, Highlander, Fanatic.[/list]

[*] Also, welcome a legendary hero of the Incineration group, Fiery Priestess, and her foil counterpart :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e0ee9e47853b6e86036bceb0c4aaa9543ea388c9.png[/img]

[*] The Queen's second effect has changed — now it deals 50% more damage to flying enemies (previously, it returned 80% of the price upon sale).
Also, the base damage for the Queen and its foil counterpart is increased by 5%

[*] The Hornet Hive and Colony of Bats now make invisible enemies visible and can attack invisible enemies (previously, they did not allow them to go invisible).

[*] Night Queen now increases the effectiveness of anomalies (instead of increasing their number).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/adfe9a0991c5873876ed8abfa94a238f64ea8a94.png[/img]
[*] Fixed a bug with the Might Rune (and double runes with this effect) not affecting some towers.

[*] Fixed a bug with Flying Smasher and Snowball's projectiles that sometimes were floating in the air.[/list]

See you!

notes.title: Announcement of future changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4d157efc137615ee28dfca0b3a5b704254930cc7.png[/img]

Defenders!

We continue telling you about the planned in-game changes. And today it is time to discuss the most mysterious and exciting thing for the players — crafting system.
And not only about that ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Chests Update[/h2]

Before getting to the most important part of the announcement, let's talk about something we have planned as the next step after the Hero rebalance and will introduce into the game with the next update — [b]the update of chest contents[/b].

First of all, we would like to note that the current system of getting Heroes is confusing, incomprehensible, and often tiresome. Sometimes a significant amount of card shards, time, and even essences is required to receive a golden chest. It is noticeably out of line if we take the process of getting the rest of the cards in the game into consideration and make the process of farming Heroes too long and complicated.

[b]Therefore, we decided to give up the Hero chests and add Hero cards, just like tokens, to the regular chests that you receive for winning on the location[/b].

The rarity of Heroes and tokens, dropping from the chests, will be determined according to the current system, which means the whole process of getting Heroes will become much easier, including those of the legendary rarity ːsteamhappyː
And, of course, you no longer have to spend tokens on Hero chests because you will only need them for evolution.

Thus, getting all types of cards — Towers, Spells, Heroes — will become more transparent, uniform, and affordable. The need to level-up and sell cards will become a thing of the past. The reason for this is the fact that unnecessary card shards will now be used to a greater extent to level-up and create the cards that you need.

[h2]Red Chests[/h2]

Of course, we cannot help but take care of the highest-level chests in the game, the mythic ones.
First, getting such chests is pretty much tied to the players' activity now, and that is something they cannot control (to an extent).
Second, unlike the other chests, you cannot receive runes from mythic ones, and when you are at a high level, a lot often depends on how well the runes are upgraded and how many bonuses they give.
And as a whole, these chests are not in line with the general system, and sometimes it confuses players who have just reached level 90.

[b]With this in mind, we are planning to do the following[/b]:
[*] Add mythic chests to the battle rewards (both in PvP and PvE locations);
[*] Bring their content to a unified form — apart from card shards, there will be silver, resources, and runes.[/list]
It means that level 90 players will be able to receive mythic chests more often, and collecting runes of high rarity will become easier. After all, legendary runes will be in the red chests! And also valuable runes with a double effect 😃

At the same time, red chests will remain at the store, and you can buy them for both Red Crystals and Stars.

[h2]Crafting System for Tower, Spell, and Hero Cards[/h2]

We decided to introduce the crafting system with what constitutes the basis of the game — Tower, Spell, and Hero cards.

At the moment, it can be quite difficult to get the right Tower, even with the fact that the card shards are a part of the battle reward, can be found in random stores, and are available for viewing ads.
We want to make the process of getting cards that the player needs more understandable and controllable. For this purpose, we are introducing the crafting system into the game.

[b][u]It will work as follows:[/u][/b]
[*] You can choose a card or card shard [b]from those available in the collection[/b] to create a new card;
[*] There will be a special button in the card menu that will take you directly to the crafting interface;
[*] There, you can choose which cards from the inventory you would like to convert to the ones you have selected at the first stage.[/list]

[b]Besides, by doing this, you get a chance of receiving a bonus — shards of card's foil analog or other special cards[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/91a23b4c862abbe311a1daf9314583678e687c5f.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7672439042b7988b10b3caac6fe62546771499e0.png[/img]

Thus, you will have full control of getting the cards you need and/or their duplicates (to increase the Quantity parameter, for example). And, as a bonus, receive foil counterparts of your favorite cards :)

Runes crafting will work on a similar principle (except for the foil counterparts, of course), but will be brought to the game a bit later.

We are also preparing a considerable amount of foil Heroes, new Heroes, and other changes that will make the game more engaging and fun 😃
