notes.title: Update 1.9.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b7a565fd75cf72c9de1918946d5307916a7e84f8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ee5b66a0a43ae0423965bd74b7a22a71d6f39fb1.png[/img]

Defenders!

We are introducing Defenders 2's new weekly Battle Passes! With them, you can, depending on the PvE-mode, get the cards you need — shards of Towers and Spells, Runes, or other resources. Just like "in the good old days."

[*] [b]Battle Pass: Assault[/b] will let you get many runes for Towers and Spells;
[*] [b]Battle Pass: Raid[/b] will let you increase the number of valuable resources;
[*] [b]Battle Pass: Hunt[/b] will let you obtain shards of Towers and Spells cards.

To get rewards, you need to clear difficult levels in PvE locations (“swords” on the map) of the corresponding mode. Each difficult level you beat gets you higher and higher on the Battle Pass levels and allows you to receive greater rewards.

Each pass has two lines of prizes — a free one, which is available without any additional conditions, and a paid one, which prizes are available only if you purchase a specific Battle Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b25ca86bdaad453bdee96be38512d9458cd1dcbf.png[/img]

The global rebalancing of the Hero system is here!

[*] For each group of Towers and Spells there is its own line of Heroes now, that gives bonuses to the required parameters;

[*] You can take only one Hero from the group into battle.

[*] The Hero's rarity now determines cards of what color their bonus will apply to. The higher the rarity of the Tower or Spell is, the rarer the Hero must be to enhance it;

[*] Also, the value and even the number of bonuses depend on the rarity of the Hero. For example, the rarest (mythic) hero will give the cards of his group as many as three bonuses, including additional upgrades in battle!

[*] Besides, we have revised the value of the Hero bonuses — we have increased them.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/12a0f5bc83095c2e11ddd357799ea7c79060ec72.png[/img]

New heroes have appeared in the game:

[*] [b]Mythic:[/b] Shaman (for the Energy and Totems group), Patriot (for the Direct Damage group), Berserk Alpha (for the Area Damage group), Squink (for the Against Underground Enemies group).

[*] [b]Legendary:[/b] Head Hunter (for the Direct Damage group), Primologist (for the Enhancement and Repair group), Berserker (for the Area Damage group), Mort (for the Poison group), Lightning (for the Prime Towers and Anti-Totems group).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f419abfa998ba79a092d670b699833e77ae94147.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Now the cards of Heroes, who are hired on the ship, have a SHIP marker in the collection;
[*] Freeze now slows down only ground creeps;
[*] Fanatic now increases the amount of Prime at the beginning of a battle;
[*] Heroes that have an impact on the battle strategy are united in groups:
[list]
[*] Fanatic, Highlander, Defender are in the [b]Servants group[/b];
[*] Lady Frost, Snow Maiden, Da'Ka are in the [b]Brisk group[/b];
[*] Freeze, Dendromonster, Fay are in the [b]Containment group[/b].
[/list]
Like other Heroes of the same group, they cannot be recruited at the same time.

[*] Besides, Snow Maiden, Highlander, and Da'Ka now give effects to all cards, including mythic ones.
[/list]
You can get these Heroes in special events. Do not miss them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/5f7b8a61957c09d88ee32d0365585791629ae71d.png[/img]

In this version we have also revised the formulas and mechanics for gaining experience.
[list]
[*] Now the main way to gain experience is by merging cards. At the same time, you will still be able to gain experience in battles, but it will be more of a pleasant bonus than the main way of leveling up;

[*] The amount of experience gained per battle reaches its maximum at level 90 of any location. For battles at a higher level (for example, mines of level 200, 350, etc.), the cards will receive the same amount of experience as they do at level 90.

[*] Each card gives a fixed amount of experience, depending on its rarity. The higher is the rarity, the more experience you will get ːsteamhappyː

[*] If a similar card is used for merging, the amount of experience will be several times higher;

[*] Bonuses from the ship and Heroes will also affect the process of getting experience.
[/list]
[quote][b]Please note![/b]
[list]
[*] If the card used for merging already has a certain amount of experience (i.e. the card level is above 1), then it will be added to the merging experience. However, the ship's and heroes' and/or coefficients for merging identical cards will not work in this case.

[*] Given the fact that cards of high rarity are giving much more experience when merging now, the requirements for leveling up have also been raised.

[*] The higher is the rarity of the card, the more experience it will take to level up, up to the maximum level 90.
[/list][/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0a4d951e8291cff9bb6643a0e0ad0433199cd497.png[/img]

The shards system has become even more clear and convenient!
[list]
[*] The shards with the NEW marker will now be displayed first;

[*] After them, there will be all the shards from which you can collect at least 1 whole card, separated according to the basic rarity;

[*] And at the end there will be the shards which are not enough to collect the whole card, also separated according to the basic rarity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a49c6f03b0476f4369facdd4bb817fb6cc922187.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Upgrading the Frost Tower in battle increases the slowing down effect;

[*] Foil bonus for the Snow Cannon has been changed to a 20% increase in the slowing down effect;

[*] Fixed a bug with the foil Underground Predator that made it impossible to insert runes that increase the effect duration;

[*] Fixed a bug with the Flying Saucer's damage;

[*] Fixed a bug with the Towers where in some cases it was possible to upgrade them by using All-Purpose Gears of a lesser rarity.
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Rebalance Announce
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/5ff9157719d9cb41401930f3e4d13e066ea3af12.png[/img]

Dear Friends!

Recently, we have started working on global rebalances to make gameplay more effective, interesting, and understandable for players of all levels. The tower system was redesigned before the start of the current season. That change brought some new tactics to the game and made fighting the creeps and other players more interesting.
Today we would like to tell you about the next stage — planned changes in the Hero system that will come to the game by the start of the next season.

As you have noted on more than one occasion, not every tower or spell can get proper bonuses from Heroes, which affects their effectiveness in battle. For example, the damage increase for Meteor is a bonus that, in players' opinion, does not correspond to the tower's concept and its application.
Besides, it is not uncommon to encounter a situation where green heroes gave more bonuses than blue ones, and that leads to confusion. It is expected, after all, that rarer heroes are more effective than their less rare counterparts.
Even more, not every tower and spell has a hero with bonuses just for them.

[h2]1. Card groups[/h2]
For towers and spells to get the necessary and useful bonuses from the Heroes, we:
have divided them into groups according to the bonus type,
have picked a hero lineup for every group with bonuses to the necessary parameters,
and, finally, have made a change that will let the Hero rarity to not only impact the main parameter but also give even more bonuses.

Also, now the Hero rarity determines the cards of which color will get the Hero bonus — the higher is the tower or spell's rarity, the rarer should be the Hero to give them bonuses.

- Green Heroes will give a bonus to one parameter for cards up to special ones;
- Blue Heroes will also give a bonus to one parameter but with a higher percentage than Green ones have and for cards up to epic ones;
- Purple Heroes will give a bonus to two parameters for cards up to legendary ones;
- Red Heroes will also give a bonus to two parameters but with a higher percentage than Purple ones and for all cards in the group;
- And the highest level, Red Heroes. They will give the highest bonus to two parameters and additionally increase the number of towers or spell upgrades in battle.

As for specific groups and bonuses to card parameters:
- For Direct Damage groups (Machinegun, Tower of the Sun, Minigun, etc.), Area Damage (Mortar, Electric Tower, etc.), Prime Towers and Anti-Totems (Prime Cannon, Detonator, etc. ), Against Flying Enemies (Incandescent Core, etc.), and Against Underground Enemies (Indestructible Idol, etc.) the damage and rate of fire will be increased;
- For a Fire Group (Volcano, Dragon Tower, etc.) and a Poison Group (Hornet Hive, Colony of Bats, etc.) the damage and effect duration will be increased;
- For Slowdown (Time Warp, Frost Guard, etc.) the slowdown effect and range will be increased;
- For Curses (Curse, Spider Nest, etc.) the curse effect and its duration will be increased;
- For Stunning (Flaming Cannon, Meteor, etc.) and Fear (Banshee Tower, League Shiny Crest, etc.) the chance of applying the effect and its duration will be increased;
- For Special Towers ​​(Purifier, Tower of Order, etc.) the damage and duration will be increased;
- For Enhancements (Aim Tower, Deadly Strike, etc.) the effect strength and range will be increased.

Thus, every tower and spell will get useful bonuses from the Hero, and their effectiveness will increase depending on the Hero, even with additional improvements in battle at the mythic level.
It will make the system clear, intuitive, and allow players to transition more smoothly to high-level towers and spells. And at level 90 they will be able to consciously use mythical cards in the most effective combinations.

In addition to dividing the Heroes into groups to strengthen towers and spells, we have put some Heroes into groups based on battle strategies. They will give significant bonuses to all towers and magic, but at the same time, the player can take only one group bonus into battle.

[h2]2. Changes in Card Upgrade[/h2]
Now, experience for cards can be obtained in two ways: in battle or through merging cards with each other.
The card gets more experience from the Session, but firstly, a non-upgraded (therefore, ineffective) tower or spell is often taken into battle, and secondly, you cannot upgrade Heroes in battle.
At the same time, very little experience is given when merging cards, the mechanics behind the process is opaque and not clear.
Players quite often complain about these problems and ask us to make a convenient way to level up cards. And in the upcoming update, we will make it happen! To make it more simple and convenient, now the merging will be the main way to upgrade cards. It will be the same for all card types. Plus it became much more convenient with the latest interface changes. The experience increase in battle will also be there, but it will remain more as a pleasant bonus than the main way of upgrading.

Of course, the amount of experience when merging will be significantly increased. Besides, to make it clearer, we have changed the calculation formula:

Now each card gives the same amount of experience for each rarity, regardless of the level of its evolution. The higher the rarity, the more experience will be obtained
If the same cards are merged then the amount of experience will be greatly increased.
Feeders (Hammers and Emblems) will serve as jokers and give an additional increase when they are merged with any other cards.
All bonuses from Heroes and ship talents will also affect the amount of experience gained.

Moreover, if some of the cards used for the merging already have some amount of previously gained experience, it will be summed up and added to the current merge, but neither bonuses from Heroes, ship talents, nor the multiplier from the same cards will apply to it.

Besides, since the cards of high rarity give much more experience than before, the requirements for getting experience also increased. The higher the rarity, the more experience you will need to reach level 90.

[quote]So, for the next Season, we have planned one of the most anticipated changes in the game — the crafting system! :) We will tell you about this and the planned resource mines remake later.
[/quote]

Are your heroes ready to fight the Prime Zone with renewed vigor?

- For a Fire Group (Volcano, Dragon Tower, etc.) and a Poison Group (Hornet Hive, Colony of Bats, etc.) the damage and effect duration will be increased;

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/5e9ef0471010fa48dfb38e960fba785c8716c65a.png[/img]

Dear friends!

As you already know, [b]the update 1.8.8[/b] brought global rebalances to the game. Unfortunately, several nasty bugs also crept in, and because of that, the game balance turned out completely different from what we originally planned.

We have fixed these bugs in today's hotfix and, at the same time, re-launched the season. There were several reasons for this decision.

First of all, we would like to avoid a situation where a player could rise to a level that they would not normally be able to reach because their Towers dealt an abnormally high amount of damage. 
Besides, we want the contest to be as fair and competitive as possible throughout the season. Gaining the rating points too easily contradicts these plans and may lead to a situation where players could raise the mines’ level so high that it would be impossible to catch up with them.

However, we, of course, will not roll back your progress or rob you in any way of whatever you have gained during this time.

As a gratitude for your support, we have prepared a fair compensation for you, 300 Stars. You can collect them in your in-game mailbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/97fcb78dba976252e1d05964eb6266300593c2c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that greatly increased damage of some Towers (including their league counterparts): Deadly Poison Shooter, Dragon Tower, Sky Burner, Volcano, Pumpkin Gun, Hornet Hive, Colony of Bats. Now their damage corresponds to the original plan.

[*] Fixed the bug with a double bonus that the Volcano and Pumpkin Launcher received from the Heroes Vixen and Fire Fox.

[*] Fixed the bug with the Colony of Bats that increased the Tower range, instead of the damage when you upgraded this Tower in battle.

[*] Fixed the bug that did not stack the damage increase from the Deadly Strike and the same effect from the Prime Injector or the Aim Tower.

[*] Fixed the bug where slowing down effects did not stack up.

[*] Fixed the bug with the UP marker that would appear on cards even if they could not be upgraded.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.8.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/07b838925ca4673cdccf3edf06b0d5c646eadb4e.png[/img]

Defenders!

The update 1.8.8 has been installed. The Prime Zone is waiting for you!

The game rebalances, which we talked about earlier, have appeared in the game today. Now the towers and magic cards are much more in line with the idea of collectivity and the Tower Defense genre.

Besides, many systems have become more understandable, logical and comfortable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b0edcf4e2018b74b3edd3a12b6f5291bea80dac4.png[/img]
Now when you receive or purchase more than 3 chests, you can see all the chests loot immediately.
No more watching the chest opening animation many times in a row! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f2a3aff69f34b0770e27c018943f34d39309151b.png[/img]
Now there is a legendary analog of the players' favorite Deadly Strike in the game — Merciless Strike. Using this magic increases tower damage by 25%.

You can get it in special events. Do not miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7b9605b7ebffc70db0671cd2ff7e4ccc4ccf992c.png[/img]
The card management has become much more convenient — now you can control the fuse and sale with the accuracy of one card, even in shards!
[list]
[*] In the multisell and fuse interfaces, you can now see two new buttons — '+1' and '+max'. They will help you control the selection of runes and chards (in increments of one card) when you sell or fuse them.

[*] Also, now at the very top of the window in the multisell interface, you can see the amount and type of currency you will get by selling selected cards or shards.
At the same time, if there are not enough shards for at least one card, selling such a pack will be impossible.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4f3df0926a633889c892d6ae50acfb93cfe61e05.png[/img]
Now all the effects add up, but only if they come from different sources.

Thus, a 20% increase in damage from the Accursed Bastion, 20% from the Spider Nest, and 20% from the Curse will add up and will give a 60% increase in damage to the Creeps.
At the same time, 20% of one Accursed Bastion and 20% of another Accursed Bastion will not add up.

The same goes for tower buffs, damage over time, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/82e65ae32e11e28cbe282d06e5c70ffb463fdc0e.png[/img]
Now upgrading the Tower increases only the main impact parameter. For damage towers, this is damage, the strength of buffs or debuffs for support towers, and the chance of triggering for counter towers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f7667c37a2cff5ce09beac24fc6eec99d0ee900f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The towers have received an increase in damage (including league counterparts): Deadly Poison Shooter, Totem Bane, Dragon Tower, Machinegun, Sniper Tower, Ice Tower, Splitter, Deadly Prime Cannon, Machinegun MK2, Fire Tower, Air Guard, Mortar, Seismic Slammer, Spirit Tower, Detonator, Sky Burner, Underground Predator, Lightning Tower, Tower of the Sun, Volcano, Hornet Hive, Electric Tower, Prime Arrester, League Prime Thistle, Flying Cannon, Flying Saucer, Flying Spray, Sniper Rifle, Tornado Generator, Indestructible Idol, Incandescent Core, Ghost Tower, Pumpkin Gun, Colony of Bats, Tower of Chaos, Snowball, Festival Mortar, Petard Mortar, Minigun, The Queen.

[*] The towers have received an increase in range (including league counterparts): Frost Tower, Detonator, Accursed Bastion, Frost Guard, Prime Injector, Snow Cannon, Tower of Order.

[*] The towers have received a reduction in the rate of fire (including league counterparts): Spray Tower, Seismic Slammer, Flying Cannon, Tornado Generator.

[*] The towers have received an increase in the rate of fire (including league counterparts): Electric Tower, Flying Spray.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f935701498f4c6ceb87676e90e09ff9698fd44de.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The League Underground Predator now spreads the plague among the underground Creeps (similar to what the Hornet Hive does to other Creeps);

[*] The Flying Prime Arrester is now acting similar to the Lightning Tower. Thus, this tower received a new name — Flying Lightning Tower.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/2ae5fd3794aee01ba241a3299fcf7bcf65767472.png[/img]
Magic cards will receive all the improvements (from the runes) at the start of the mission, instead of receiving one star at the beginning of every difficult level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ea31fbc540c36d4d945293fe64c793e80294c548.png[/img]
For your convenience, from now on the marker will be displayed in the following cases:
[list]
[*] If the card can be upgraded (it is possible to increase the quantity parameter or evolve the card).

[*] If there are enough shards to collect a card, and there is no such card in your collection yet.

[*] If there are enough shards to collect a card, and the number of such cards in your collection has not reached its maximum.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7a9f5909251be32eaf65d8c1665b663892a18d8f.png[/img]
We have combined chat channels, so now chatting is even more convenient and enjoyable! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where, in some cases, the Creeps did not accumulate immunity to fear.

[*] Fixed the bug where the Snowball's slowdown effect interrupted the Time Warp's slowdown.

[*] Now, when you fuse or sell an even number of shards, the empty card will not disappear from your collection.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8824a4ce09ba8b92fe576e28b9ab87a7ac74ff97.png[/img]
After watching videos, the UP marker may appear on the shard pack even if there are not enough of them to collect a card.


[i]See you![/i]

notes.title: Announcement of Global Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/57c20e36adc76615b549a704c3e74223252c5713.png[/img]

Defenders!

Today we would like to tell you about a global rebalance that is planned for the coming Off-Season.
The changes are really big — more variety will appear in the game along with them. Lots of abuses and tactics for completing any mission or mine with a combination of cards for damage + fear or damage + stun will become a thing of the past. Even players write in the comments and game chat that they are bored with the system of two or three towers — and in general this situation is not in line with the strategic genre of Tower Defense.

In addition, we are planning changes that will make the combat system much clearer for all players — for those who have joined us recently as well as for those who have already achieved a lot.

At once we will notice that any balance corrections (if they are not about obvious bugs) we are planning to introduce now and in the future, will happen only Off-Season. The reason for this is the fact that players are not ready for balance changes during intense confrontations over mines — and we respect this dedication and do not want to interfere with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/cb271998cddb6480f58392b426c06ca9d42315b5.png[/img]
The process of upgrading towers in battle works in a rather complex way — some towers get increased damage, others get increased range, etc. This system, in our opinion, is not good enough for the following reasons:
- Players do not have a clear understanding of what will happen in a battle when they upgrade a particular tower. This is especially true for new (just received) towers. A hint given to the player when they choose a rune is not always noticeable and understandable.
- In battle, some towers at a certain point ceased to increase their effectiveness with further upgrades.
- Also, this system did not work well with a number of tactics for completing missions.

As part of global rebalance, we want to bring the following to the system:
- Upgrading the tower in battle will only increase the main impact parameter. For damage towers this is damage, the strength of the buffs or debuffs for support towers and the chance of triggering for counter towers.

Here are some examples:
- Now if you upgrade the Accursed Bastion in the battle, it will increase the duration of the curse on the enemy. After the rebalance, upgrading this tower in battle will increase the main impact parameter of the tower — % of damage to the creeps.
- Upgrading the Horrifying Tower now increases its range. After the rebalance, it will increase the chance to make the enemy flee in fear.

Such a change will make battles more interesting, give the player more control over the effective use (and upgrades) of the towers and, of course, make it more simple to understand the result of a tower upgrade in battle.

As for spells, we want them to be more effective at the start of the battle.
- So, spells will get all the improvements (that they receive from runes) at the start of the mission, instead of receiving one star at the beginning of each difficult level.

This change will allow players to have more micro-control at the beginning of any mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f872707903d86b97bcb3be267e7b5da04eb65029.png[/img]
We continue to work on game effects — to leave out all abusive schemes, diversify the number of tactics and make the way effects work clearer for the players.

Now slowdown works the best (if you do not count the abuses) — it is interesting to play with, can be used in battle with great effectiveness, but at the same time, with rare exceptions, it does not simplify the flow of battle drastically.

Therefore, we decided to use the same mechanics with all effects: parameters that add up.
However, we believe that a more interesting way is to sum up effects from different sources.

Here is an example:
After the rebalance, effects of the curse will be added up. This means that a 20% increase in damage from the Accursed Bastion, 20% of the Spider's Nest and 20% of the Curse will add up and give a 60% increase in damage to the creeps.
At the same time, 20% of one Accursed Bastion and 20% of another Accursed Bastion will not add up.

The same mechanics apply to effects that cause damage over time — a variety of poisons, puddles of lava, etc.
This means that the damage of puddles from two Volcanoes will not add up, i.e. it is no longer possible to lock up the creeps with fear or stun at the location entrance and bombard them with puddles from Volcano.
At the same time, damage from the Hornet Hive and, for example, the Snake Tower will add up since these are two different sources — two different towers.

This change in mechanics of the effects will improve the situation with monotonous tactics for completing missions and at the same time make the system simple and understandable because all effects will work according to one simple scheme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/05aff7855cb489bd66fd686c96ed36ba7e3c23da.png[/img]
Another change that we would like to tell you about is the change in effectiveness of cards depending on their base rarity.
Now, almost all cards with the same number of stars (without influence of heroes and runes) have equal effectiveness — damage, range, rate of fire, etc.

We believe that this is not fully logical because the rarer a card is, the higher its effectiveness should be.
Therefore, as a part of the global rebalance, we revised parameters of the cards in such a way that now a card of higher rarity is guaranteed to be better than its less rare counterpart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f7f0bcba9594fb2e6e52bb34085fb4565f57a009.png[/img]
We are also planning to give the range of towers a specific system, so they are better suited for balanced use and maximum efficiency.

1. Short range. Towers in this group:
- Deal area damage.
- Buff allied towers with an aura.
- Weaken the creeps for some time (for example, with curse or slowdown);
2. Medium range. Towers of this group:
- Deal damage to one target (with a high rate of fire, but small damage per hit).
- Weaken monsters with auras that spread debuffs.
- Have control effects (landing, stunning, etc.).
- Deal damage over time to one target (for example, with poison).
3. Long range. This group of towers:
- Deal damage to one target (with a low rate of fire, but high damage per hit).
- Create areas on land that deal damage over time (Volcano, Pumpkin Gun).
- Dealing area damage on hit (Mortars).




These are the main comprehensive changes that we wanted to tell you about in advance.

Of course, these are not the only changes that we have made. We also revised parameters of many cards: significantly increased damage of the towers attacking one target; increased range for flying towers; revamped the intensity of applied effects for many towers.
The gameplay will cease to be straightforward, and card deck selection trivial.
Should you maximize the poisoning effect or distribute your resources into slowdown and curse? What is the best way to arrange towers for their maximum efficiency?
Also, these changes will bring back many cards that often remain in collections just to “check the box” or for sale. The situation that both we and the players who lovingly collected and upgraded many cards would like to avoid.

We would like to note right away that our work on the game balance does not end with these changes. We will continue to monitor what is going on in the game and how different towers and spells are used in various cases.

notes.title: Update 1.8.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/1313b93e4c5e39fc18241060f491af64c70b4025.png[/img]

Defenders!

Update [b]1.8.7[/b] has been installed, Primezone is ready to welcome you!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8f2b69e6eeaea04a27e823936d3e932eaef1055e.png[/img]
We’ve introduced several changes aimed at correcting the situation with lagging and freezing. Now, the game requires much less time to open a collection — even if it contains a lot of cards!

Hooray! ːsteamhappyː
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4e8844be5d0a3ff83151e71b4bc57cb5359feb84.png[/img]
We've noticed that some high-level players complained about how difficult it was for them to collect Hero Tokens of low rarity, especially the Bronze ones.  
So now, the Hiring tab on the ship has two new Packs — to exchange Hero Tokens.
[list]
[*] 1000 Bronze Tokens for 500 Silver ones
[*] 1000 Silver Tokens for 500 Gold ones
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/362012f553469c9d404993aa08cf22f4c0f4c888.png[/img]
As part of the campaign to eradicate various game abuses, we’ve introduced changes to the mechanics of the Orders. Now, the completion progress is counted only in case of victory in a battle.
It means that the creeps killed in an unfinished battled or in a lost battle even using the needed Tower are not going to be considered in the order completion progress.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/eb6b30ec6402ad232cb8ff984975aaa9037e944c.png[/img]
In response to the requests of the Mythic League players, we’ve added Epic League Cards to the Mythic League Chests as a permanent item.

Complete your collection!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/57d4bcba2f37692e7fbea6bf737d7079168a7c4f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Now, all new cards are displayed at the beginning of your collection. And the “[b]NEW[/b]” indicator disappears after opening a full description of a card, or after clicking on a different tab.

[*] The card placement changes according to the same principle — either by clicking on the card or on a different tab.

[*] Sorting according to a slot in the Runes tab has been improved. Now, Tower Runes are displayed first (according to the decreasing rarity), after them — Spell Runes.
To make it more user-friendly, we’ve divided Tower and Spell Runes into different blocks.

[*] Now, the Rune interface, which opens after a card upgrade, displays runes in the same way as the Rune Collection interface — as one card with its total number.

[*] Moreover, now, after a card upgrade the runes that can’t be put in this card will not be displayed.

[*] The Ship interface has also been improved. Now, Talents in all groups have been sorted from the cheapest to the most expensive.
 
[*] Interfaces of both Resource and League Mines now have a button with a tip.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a49c6f03b0476f4369facdd4bb817fb6cc922187.png[/img]
As you already know, recently we сhanged Duelist’s bonus, so that this Hero wouldn’t introduce a significant imbalance to the game process.
Yet, an error was detected, which now has been rectified.

Now, Duelist can replay a mission only once.

 
See you!

notes.title: Summer Ice Cream!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b1aa462bb065281b2eb0a2f335688d959ef9d487.png[/img]

Defenders!

Snow Maiden couldn’t resist coming back after seeing how many people had asked for her return. And despite this hot summer, she’s ready to join brave teams of Heroes!
But to pull through the summer heat, she needs special ice cream made from sweet Clover.

[h2]Summer Ice Cream![/h2]

Dear friends! We’ve noticed that many of you have been asking for Snow Maiden to appear before the next New Year, and of course, we couldn’t stay silent. 
For this event, as a reward for spins you can receive shards of a rare and valuable Hero — Snow Maiden!

And, of course, you can get many other valuable rewards: 
🔥 Shards of Towers and Spells, (including the league ones!);
🔥 A wide variety of Runes, including Runes with double and even triple effects;
🔥 Shards of useful Heroes;
🔥 Premium, All-Purpose Gears, Blessed Hammers, Spell Amplifiers, Ice Emblems, Silver, Essences, and Hero Tokens.

💥Players of the 90 level can receive Red Crystals, Shards of Mythic Towers and [b]Mythic[/b] All-Purpose Gears! :)

[quote]Please note! If you reach level 60 or 90 during the event, the new event will begin, and your number of spins and Clover will be reset. In this case, you can contact our tech support and we will send you a compensation to make the start in the new event more pleasant and quick.[/quote]

Also, we’ve noticed that you like the new mechanics of receiving event currency (through battles) more than the previous one (through orders) — so we’ve decided to use the new one for the Summer Ice Cream event :)

You can get Clover:
Via in-game methods (get twice more Clover by activating Premium):
🔹 as a reward for each battle (including completing difficult levels); 
🔹 opening chests located on the map.
Via other ways:
🔹 watching ads (on mobile devices);
🔹 purchases with stars ([b]3000 Clover for 100 Stars!).

The event will last until July 13.
⏱ 23:59 UTC July 12 is the last minute you can get Clover via in-game methods. Clover you’ve already collected will be stored on your account for 24 hours.
⏱ Until 23:59 UTC July 13, you will be able to use remaining Clover to spin the wheel. 
⏱ After that, Clover will disappear from your account.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b9d68685b32ddc94f26434a93bf326e87a5c908f.png[/img]
Defenders!

This hotfix is aimed at fixing errors with some Mythic Heroes which appeared after the latest update release.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/046759cea2c47d8b3602af67796ebfdfef7f49b4.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/64f4a1e3dc6440b21d6e53b8bd22e7a97a60c5bf.png[/img]
A new season has started in the game! PvP-ratings have been reset, all resource mines now belong to the creeps. Primezone is ready to welcome brave Defenders who will prove in battles that they are the best!

Please note that for being in the TOP of the rating at the end of the season you will receive rewards:
• from 1 to 3 place — mythic chevron-card;
• from 4 to 10 place — legendary chevron-card;
• from 11 to 100 place — epic chevron-card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d65c172d2c234ef2ef6bfcf41510de6e31010d01.png[/img]
We continue to add towers to league rewards! With this update you get a chance to receive:

• Deadly Prime Cannon — a completely new modification of Prime Cannon;
• League Purifier — previously it was available only at events, now its shards can be found in leagues, starting from Gold I.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d3b9782845bb2f5554effbda93693897be3dc3fc.png[/img]
Event interface has become more user-friendly!

Yes, you can click on any icon — click on any card to learn more about it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/438397e20542b271fe25431d8f120fb1f7e5ddbd.png[/img]

Consequently, the following pairs of Heroes cannot be hired at the same time:
• Nosferatu — Quarrier;
• Wendigo — Da’Ka;
• Trickster — Highlander.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/601500a879faeaaaf9ff1c1d89dcadcb52057798.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a49c6f03b0476f4369facdd4bb817fb6cc922187.png[/img]

notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/046759cea2c47d8b3602af67796ebfdfef7f49b4.jpg[/img]

Friends! 

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4772d7ec7740805dcdf242df7e61d8bb6bd50276.png[/img]

With every update League Mines become more popular and interesting for players of all levels. The previous update introduced a chance to earn rating in all leagues and receive daily rewards for it, this update introduces new league cards. 

[quote]Now in chests you can find, for example, shards of league Machinegun MK 2 and some other towers which previously did not have additional “silver star”:[list]
[*] Machinegun MK 2 — League Bonus: damage increased by 20%; 
[*] Engineering Tower — League Bonus: speed of repair increased by 20%; 
[*] Hornet Hive — League Bonus: damage increased by 20%; 
[*] Snow Cannon — League Bonus: damage increased by 20%; 
[*] Flaming Cannon — League Bonus: chance of stun increased by 20%; 
[*] Lightning Tower — League Bonus: damage increased by 20%; 
[*] Electric Tower — League Bonus: damage increased by 20%.
[/list] 
Another great new feature — league magic! You heard it right, apart from shards of towers, in chests you can find shards of league Meteor and True Vision:[list]
[*] Meteor — League Bonus: damage increased by 20%; 
[*] True Vision — League Bonus: range increased by 20%.
[/list][/quote]
Be the first to collect new league cards! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7ccb75ee30df0b7a1a0aa93bca1383078ead03a7.png[/img]

We continue to improve the interface to make it more comfortable to play Defenders 2 :)

[h3]Improved Rune Interface [/h3]
We’ve listened to your requests and now the rune interface allows to sort “stones” by slots — from 1 to 7 :)  The display of runes according to rarity will stay the same — from cyan to white. And to make it more convenient, first all runes for towers will be shown according to their slots, then — runes for spells. 

We have also changed the way identical “stones” are shown. Now identical runes will be displayed as one card and their number will be shown under the card. Please note that the marker “NEW” will appear only if you receive a completely new rune. If you add the runes that you already have, the marker won’t appear. 

[h3]Improved Card Sorting [/h3]
It has become easier to find towers and spells you need, because towers and spells can now be sorted by their basic rarity (color). In this case cards will be displayed in the following way: basic rarity (from the rarest to the least rare) → current rarity → card level → name. 

[h3]Improved Interface of the Shop [/h3]
We have added a couple of changes to the random shop. Now, in the random shop by pressing a card icon you can open a card window, where you can check complete information about it and buy the item. To make it faster and more convenient to refresh random shop’s pages, we have removed the pop-up window asking for a confirmation to change slots. 

We have also added new interface features, now you can instantly see the amount of your currency in the window where you can spend it. For example, the Hiring tab now shows supplies of Bronze, Silver, and Gold tokens. And players of level 90 will see the number of red crystals. 

[h3]Other Interface Improvements [/h3]
To make it more convenient for you to manage your cards, we added buttons Fuse Locked and Shared to the main collection menu. Sharing your cards with friends on Facebook and protecting them from accidentally selling or fusing together has become easier and faster! 

The Attack button has become “smarter” and learned new useful tricks. Now if there are no active missions on the map, but there are some unexplored territories, pressing the Attack button will make your ship move towards the unexplored area. 

And the last change in the interface — small but cool :) Now by opening a chest you will instantly see the number of shards you’ve received for each card! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/368d6f265b8c8d5726c29366339f8f912d0a4e1b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed descriptions of various cards, including rune cards 
[*] Fixed errors in effects and mechanics of some runes. 
[*] Runes for towers, and not only for spells, are given as a daily reward for league rating. 
[*] Fixed an error which caused Quarrier not to increase health of towers. 
[*] Rune prices in the new interface correspond with the prices in the old one. 
[*] We renamed the Mastery Rune for towers Gift Rune so it doesn’t get confused with the Mastery Rune for spells.
[/list]

notes.title: Time of Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/33bafe12c3931865321f48ff09471d4f0337836d.png[/img]

Defenders! 

While having a friendly chat on board of a ship Chronicle learned that you urgently needed to get special towers. Previously their shards rarely appeared in Primezone, but they all have ended up in the hands of collectors who don’t want to give up such prized possessions. 

Willing to help you, Chronicle has found a way to do so. She’s ready to build a time machine which will take you to the past and will let you find the desired shards. But to build this machine she needs special Mechanisms. If you gather enough of them then some extra-valuable towers will be added to your collection! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/dd0c13ec0aaf6dd80679eaa4c8afab87b0094e4e.png[/img]

Before you go on a hunt for Mechanisms, we want to inform you that this event is organized according to the [b]NEW RULES[/b]!

We always listen carefully to what our community has to say and we see that not everyone likes the system of receiving event currency through tasks. Some players view it as a mundane job, and as a result, they enjoy the game less. And it makes us sad :( We also know that some players, especially those who are new to the game and those at the middle level, would like essences not to disappear from the rewards in the tasks during events. 

[quote]To make it more convenient for you, we have changed the principles of event-currency dropping from different sources, by shifting the focus from passive earning through tasks and chests on the map to active one — directly through battles! Previously the amount of event currency given for victory was minute. But now, every battle is worth a triumphant victory:[list]
[*] The amount of event currency for all battles — of any difficulty level — has been increased by 12.5 times! Now, for every victory you will get 25 event currency units instead of 2. 
[*] By shifting the focus to event currency for battles, we have decreased its amount in chests — from 125 to 50 units. 
[*] Also, we have completely removed event currency from the tasks, so that players have a chance to earn additional essences during events.
[/list] 
We want to remind you that Premium doubles the amount of event currency received both for battles and chests. Players with Premium subscription will:[list]
[*] Receive 50 event currency units for every victory! 
[*] Find 100 event currency units in chests!
[/list][/quote]
The new system lets you participate in battles the way you want and gives you an opportunity to receive essences for completing the tasks :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/17a67d26c8001e4a8a0dec99682ba7364b943f8a.png[/img]

Now, let’s talk about the details of the events and rewards you get for them :) 

This time there are three events for players of 15-59, 60-89, and 90 levels. 

During the events players of all levels can get rare event towers — Incombustible Blackthorn, Mermaid’s Tower, Indestructible Idol, Tornado Generator, Incandescent Core, Sniper Rifle, and Flying Spray. Also, as a reward you can get several days of Premium, various runes — including the cyan ones, and all types of essences and Hero tokens. 

Exclusively for 15-89 level players we’ve added guaranteed rewards of rare flying towers — Flying Prime Arrester and Sky Eye. 

During the events players of level 90 can win valuable red crystals, and for the maximum number of spins they will get the grand-prize — Mythic All-Purpose Gear! 

[quote]Please note that if during the events you upgrade your account from level 59 to 60, or from level 89 to 90, then the number of spins and Mechanisms will be reset. All current rewards will be saved and you will be able to take part in another event with even cooler rewards! Moreover, in such cases, to make your start in a new event easier, you can contact our tech [url=https://nival.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]support[/url] and we will send you several Mechanisms as a compensation :)[/quote] 
Apart from the tasks and increased amount of currency for victories in battles, the mechanics of the events has not changed. Collect Mechanisms, spin the wheel, and receive valuable gifts. The more you spin, the more valuable your rewards get! 

[h3]You can collect Mechanisms using:[/h3] 
In-game methods (get twice as many Mechanisms by activating Premium):[list]
[*] winning in battles; 
[*] opening chests located on the map.
[/list] 
Other methods:[list]
[*] watching ads on mobile devices; 
[*] purchasing with stars (3000 Mechanisms for 100 stars!).
[/list] 
[h3]Events will last until June 15, but take note that:[/h3][list]
[*] Starting from 11:59 p.m. UTC June 14, you will no longer be able to collect Mechanisms. Mechanisms you’ve already collected will be stored on your account for 24 hours. 
[*] Until 11:59 p.m. UTC June 15, you will be able to use remaining Mechanisms to spin the wheel. 
[*] After that, Mechanisms will disappear from your account.
[/list] 
Let’s get those collectible towers!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends! 

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

Please, bear in mind! 
If you have turned off the automatic game update, you need to update the game manually. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/859d7355dcd24d6000e8f5605823cc05c787901d.png[/img]

The new season in Defenders 2 has begun! PvP ratings were reset and creeps took over all resource mines. The Prime Zone is ready to meet brave Defenders who will soon vie for the title of the best warrior! 

Players who occupy the top of the rating will receive the following rewards: [list]
[*] places from 1 to 3—a mythic chevron card; 
[*] places from 4 to 10—a legendary chevron card; 
[*] places from 11 to 100—an epic chevron card. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7352a01c95ebcb01be65bce18c50a42d762faf65.png[/img]

The new Season brings more interesting league battles that will suit all the players—even beginners who are just getting their foot on the rating ladder! From now on, you can enter the league battle as soon as the first league mine unlocks. Moreover, you can get daily rewards for your achievements (just like the rewards for regular PvP rating)! 

Your reward is various runes. The higher your rating position, the greater the reward! Also, each day of the week corresponds to a certain slot. For example, on Monday you get a first-slot rune, on Tuesday, a second-slot and so on. 

You can claim your daily rewards in the menu of league mines, in the Rewards tab. 

[quote]Rating points are calculated on the same principle in all the leagues: [list]
[*] points are awarded after every single competition and in every single mine; then they are added to the total rating; 
[*] players in the red area don't receive PvP points; 
[*] players in the blue area receive the number of points equal to the reached mine level; 
[*] players in the green zone receive the number of points equal to the reached mine level + 20%.
[/list][/quote]
We also slightly tweaked the global map interface: the indicator of available mines (as well as mines where you occupy the red area) now goes out after you review the corresponding tabs. However, it will be displayed again as you relog into the game. This way you can keep track of every change. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/85d68852614d457bbf3f20dc5a06f66adfcf7b97.png[/img]

Several new runes now grant higher characteristics to towers and spells. 

Night Queen no longer eliminates disasters. Instead, she adds anomalies to the map. This change will diversify your tactics as you complete the missions. After all, even one disaster is enough to significantly influence your decisions and the battle course. 

As we promised, Duelist's ability was slightly changed. Now Duelist has a certain chance to activate a bonus mission. This chance depends on the mission difficulty and the Hero's level. Since the Hero was balanced, you can find him in the chests again. 

Slow value in the Time Warp card became 5 times higher—up to 450 (instead of 90). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7e7fd61ca4c0abdb87c438cad37822322c9b9ffa.png[/img]

Following your feedback, we changed the "Battle!" button on the global map. It became smaller and less distracting :) Additionally, we removed the indicator with the number of available PvE missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/368d6f265b8c8d5726c29366339f8f912d0a4e1b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Flaming Cannon now properly brings flying creeps to the ground. 
[*] Colony of bats can no longer cleanse creeps' invisibility. It can't see monsters hidden in fog but prevents the damaged creeps from becoming invisible. 
[*] Fixed counters for Slothcat and Pollywogs. Colony of bats is no longer showed as their counter tower. 
[*] Fixed a visual bug when a PvP reward notification showed near the Quests tab.
[*] Exchange rate of stars for silver is now always updated and correct 
[*] Fixed descriptions of Heroes who slow down creeps. They now display accurate values instead of %. 
[*] Fixed several inaccuracies in the rune descriptions. 
[*] Short description of towers was enlarged. It now shows values that were previously displayed in the full description only.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.8.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a7ffa881eab76ab056002756fae34be9066b3c02.png[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/dc8c7c7a79a63517aefea932f4b46e7ea44b3610.png[/img]
Introducing the updated rune interface and long-awaited merging of all runes! That's right! You won't have to upgrade each rune separately anymore  Although, this possibility remains too.

The updated interface is in the collection menu, where the Feeders tab used to be. Its features resemble those of the tower, spell, and Hero interfaces. Apart from automerging, it has the rune multisell option too! As for feeders, All-Purpose Gears and Blessed Hammers are moved to the Towers tab, and Spell Amplifiers and Ice Emblems, to the Spells tab. Feeders are located right after the cards (before card shards).

We've also added some new runes for towers and spells! Equip them to discover new exciting tactics to fight creeps and create more effective builds. For example, there are new more relevant runes for support cards in the second slot (not just damage-boosting).

You may notice some locked options: Craft, Break, and Evolve. It's a small teaser to future updates 

[b]To ease the collection process for you, with this update we are launching a themed event![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ace3f2979a72e5c4cbab05f099e4925cd4c02e15.png[/img]
Prices for rare, epic, and legendary chests became 5–6 times lower:

• 10 rare chests—50 stars instead of 225!
• 10 epic chests—100 stars instead of 450!
• 10 legendary chests—150 stars instead of 900!

This isn't a temporal event — from now on, you'll always buy chests at extremely favorable prices!

Please note that:
• chests are no longer sold by the piece;
• bonuses for a one-time purchase of 10-chest boosters were removed;
• in the mobile version, you can still get rare chests by the piece for watching ads.

Moreover, the star-for-silver exchange became 10 times more profitable! The exchange rate is 1000 Silver for 1 Star (instead of 100 Silver). Yet, prices in Silver remain the same!

Premium will now grant one more useful bonus—a possibility to get a double reward in leagues.

Rune prices in daily and weekly offers became up to 17 times lower!

• Daily offers now contain 14 rare runes instead of 3, and the booster costs half the previous price (9 times more profitable)!
• Weekly offers now have 14 epic runes instead of 2, while the total price of the booster is 2.5 times lower (17 times more profitable)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/1188655d83089f85fd1526ce9f1b423f6b9d079b.png[/img]
We noticed that the system of seasons was received with great enthusiasm! Players are fighting for the prize-winning places in ratings with renewed vigor. Since PvP became a greater part of Defenders 2, we decided to make it more convenient. To do so, we reworked and improved the mine menus—both resource and league. But there are more nice changes 

[h3]League Mines[/h3]
The circle in the Mines tab of the league menu is now of the same color as the area you entered (red, blue, or green). This will make it easier to monitor your place in every single mine.

Also, the league PvP icon (the cup on the global map) now shows a certain number. It corresponds to the number of mines where you currently occupy the red area.

And in the new Season you will be recieving runes for your league rating everyday! To enter the league rating you’ll only have to open at least one league mine.

Follow the news :)

[h3]Resource Mines[/h3]
The menu of the resource mines became much clearer. It has the following tabs:
• Mines: the tab works just like the button of the same name in leagues. Here you can see the list of all available resource mines and quickly go to the one you need.
• Rating: a usual tab with the world PvP rating. Local ratings are no longer displayed since they lost their relevance due to VPN use. We removed the friends' ratings too. Earlier we mentioned that we want to reconsider the system of social interaction. Our goal is to unbind the in-game friendship from social media. Large-scale changes will come in the future. Right now we are just gradually preparing for them.
• Rewards: a familiar tab with daily rewards that used to be in the Quests tab. We moved it to the mine menu so that everything could be in one place. Much more convenient this way 

The PvP icon (two crossed swords on the global map) now also displays the number of mines, captured by other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/202c1ac66c066cca5d9a7ac2545b1af99b87279b.png[/img]
We continue to fight with abusing mechanics, including the circling-creeps-strategy that players complain about. The fixes were partially introduced in one of the previous updates. Today we introduce the second part.

Here come the reworked mechanics of stun, slow, and confusion!

[h3]Stun[/h3]
Creeps can now stack stun resistance. If you stun creeps with any tower or spell, they get bonus resistance to the effect, stacking up to complete immunity. This will prevent situations when monsters could stay stunned forever.

Let's have a look at an example. Say, we take Stun Tower. Its card now has two characteristics: basic stun chance (for instance, 35%) and creeps' resistance to stun (3%). If the tower stuns a monster, the chance will drop to 32%; after that, to 29% and so on. At some point, creeps will become completely immune to the effect. Moreover, resistance from different sources can stack too.

Naturally, while working on these changes, we also reconsidered the stun chance for corresponding towers and spells.

[h3]Slow[/h3]
Slow is now calculated differently too. Previously, slow % was subtracted directly from the creeps' speed. The maximum possible slow was 90% and only the strongest slow effect could be applied to creeps.

Now, the final speed is calculated according to the following formula: 100/(100 + Х). If a card reduces creeps' speed by 50 points, then: 100/(100+50) = 10/15, meaning the speed will be about 66% of the basic speed.

At the same time, effects from different sources can stack while the maximum slow remains the same—10x (when reduced by 900 points).

[h3]Fear[/h3]
We reconsidered the confuse mechanics. Now it's called fear/flee. When feared, creeps no longer get confused at turnings. Instead, they flee in another direction. On narrow roads, creeps will turn back; on wide arenas, they may also turn sideways. The total distance they travel depends on the effect duration. When feared, creeps gain bonus fear resistance that works just like the stun resistance.

We also reconsidered the fear chance of towers while working on the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/85d68852614d457bbf3f20dc5a06f66adfcf7b97.png[/img]
We improved several cards to make them more relevant.

Indestructible Idol now deals 4x damage to underground creeps in comparison to ground creeps.

Moreover, we increased the maximum effectiveness of the following Heroes: Da'Ka, Lightning Master, Aviator, Maiden, Mimi, Dryad, Cryo, Shadow, Fire Fox, Tearaway, Vryl, Cannoneer, Archer, S.Putnik, and Stalker. These Heroes now grant a higher bonus when upgraded to the maximum.

The Night Queen no longer removes disasters, but adds anomalies to the battle map.

The ability to re-complete missions with an active Duelist now has a certain chance of triggering. The chance value depends both on the complexity of the mission and on the level of Hero upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/8e24a10cf5476531d0eb8dd022b82203ed5ab24c.png[/img]
We prepared some more useful changes for the game interface!

The home screen now has a new button—To Battle! It shows the number of active PvE arenas. Press it to advance to a randomly selected location, available for attack. This button will enable a much easier battle search on the global map.

It's now possible for several icons to be displayed next to a player's nickname in the chat. This way, players will see your achievements—both in the classic and league PvP!

Additionally, we moved the settings back to the global map. New players will now have less trouble finding it 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/368d6f265b8c8d5726c29366339f8f912d0a4e1b.png[/img]
Naturally, we introduced several fixes into the game too:

• Tower of Chaos will attack creeps if there are totems within its range.
• Colony of bats no longer stops attacking creeps for no apparent reason.
• Indestructible Idol no longer attacks flying and invisible creeps but can deal damage to totems.
• Incombustible Blackthorn now correctly increases the slow strength as it levels up.
• Number of runes refreshes automatically after the merging.
• Mythic content is no longer displayed among the legendary chest possible content.

tags.feature: Introducing the updated rune interface and long-awaited merging of all runes! That's right! You won't have to upgrade each rune separately anymore  Although, this possibility remains too.

The updated interface is in the collection menu, where the Feeders tab used to be. Its features resemble those of the tower, spell, and Hero interfaces. Apart from automerging, it has the rune multisell option too! As for feeders, All-Purpose Gears and Blessed Hammers are moved to the Towers tab, and Spell Amplifiers and Ice Emblems, to the Spells tab. Feeders are located right after the cards (before card shards).

We've also added some new runes for towers and spells! Equip them to discover new exciting tactics to fight creeps and create more effective builds. For example, there are new more relevant runes for support cards in the second slot (not just damage-boosting).

tags.balance_change:
Prices for rare, epic, and legendary chests became 5–6 times lower:

• 10 rare chests—50 stars instead of 225!
• 10 epic chests—100 stars instead of 450!
• 10 legendary chests—150 stars instead of 900!
This isn't a temporal event — from now on, you'll always buy chests at extremely favorable prices!
Moreover, the star-for-silver exchange became 10 times more profitable! The exchange rate is 1000 Silver for 1 Star (instead of 100 Silver). Yet, prices in Silver remain the same!
Premium will now grant one more useful bonus—a possibility to get a double reward in leagues.
Rune prices in daily and weekly offers became up to 17 times lower!
• Daily offers now contain 14 rare runes instead of 3, and the booster costs half the previous price (9 times more profitable)!
• Weekly offers now have 14 epic runes instead of 2, while the total price of the booster is 2.5 times lower (17 times more profitable)!

tags.feature: The circle in the Mines tab of the league menu is now of the same color as the area you entered (red, blue, or green). This will make it easier to monitor your place in every single mine.
Also, the league PvP icon (the cup on the global map) now shows a certain number. It corresponds to the number of mines where you currently occupy the red area.
And in the new Season you will be recieving runes for your league rating everyday! To enter the league rating you’ll only have to open at least one league mine.

The menu of the resource mines became much clearer. It has the following tabs:
• Mines: the tab works just like the button of the same name in leagues. Here you can see the list of all available resource mines and quickly go to the one you need.
• Rating: a usual tab with the world PvP rating. Local ratings are no longer displayed since they lost their relevance due to VPN use. We removed the friends' ratings too. Earlier we mentioned that we want to reconsider the system of social interaction. Our goal is to unbind the in-game friendship from social media. Large-scale changes will come in the future. Right now we are just gradually preparing for them.
• Rewards: a familiar tab with daily rewards that used to be in the Quests tab. We moved it to the mine menu so that everything could be in one place. Much more convenient this way
The PvP icon (two crossed swords on the global map) now also displays the number of mines, captured by other players.

tags.bug: We noticed that the system of seasons was received with great enthusiasm! Players are fighting for the prize-winning places in ratings with renewed vigor. Since PvP became a greater part of Defenders 2, we decided to make it more convenient. To do so, we reworked and improved the mine menus—both resource and league. But there are more nice changes

tags.balance_change: Creeps can now stack stun resistance. If you stun creeps with any tower or spell, they get bonus resistance to the effect, stacking up to complete immunity. This will prevent situations when monsters could stay stunned forever.

Let's have a look at an example. Say, we take Stun Tower. Its card now has two characteristics: basic stun chance (for instance, 35%) and creeps' resistance to stun (3%). If the tower stuns a monster, the chance will drop to 32%; after that, to 29% and so on. At some point, creeps will become completely immune to the effect. Moreover, resistance from different sources can stack too.
Naturally, while working on these changes, we also reconsidered the stun chance for corresponding towers and spells.

Slow is now calculated differently too. Previously, slow % was subtracted directly from the creeps' speed. The maximum possible slow was 90% and only the strongest slow effect could be applied to creeps.

Now, the final speed is calculated according to the following formula: 100/(100 + Х). If a card reduces creeps' speed by 50 points, then: 100/(100+50) = 10/15, meaning the speed will be about 66% of the basic speed.
At the same time, effects from different sources can stack while the maximum slow remains the same—10x (when reduced by 900 points).

We reconsidered the confuse mechanics. Now it's called fear/flee. When feared, creeps no longer get confused at turnings. Instead, they flee in another direction. On narrow roads, creeps will turn back; on wide arenas, they may also turn sideways. The total distance they travel depends on the effect duration. When feared, creeps gain bonus fear resistance that works just like the stun resistance.
We also reconsidered the fear chance of towers while working on the update.
Indestructible Idol now deals 4x damage to underground creeps in comparison to ground creeps.

Moreover, we increased the maximum effectiveness of the following Heroes: Da'Ka, Lightning Master, Aviator, Maiden, Mimi, Dryad, Cryo, Shadow, Fire Fox, Tearaway, Vryl, Cannoneer, Archer, S.Putnik, and Stalker. These Heroes now grant a higher bonus when upgraded to the maximum.
The Night Queen no longer removes disasters, but adds anomalies to the battle map.
The ability to re-complete missions with an active Duelist now has a certain chance of triggering. The chance value depends both on the complexity of the mission and on the level of Hero upgrade.

notes.title: Time of Runes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/5296732eeb33f1d9397a7ca94a47c370e574d7d6.png[/img]

Defenders!

Not so long ago Ymir was able to spell out an ancient treatise. It said how to create new, previously unprecedented runes which will further increase the power of Towers and Magic.

But there’s a problem - the pages of the treatise, picked up by a hurricane, scattered throughout the Primezone...

[h3]Time of Runes![/h3]

There are two versions of the event — for level 15–89 players and level 90 and above players.

Among the rewards, level 15–89 players may find:
[list]
[*] [b]New runes[/b] with double and triple effects—up to 7-star ones
[*] Lots of towers, Heroes, and spells;
[*] Other useful prizes: keys, silver, essences, and all types of Hero Tokens.
[/list] 

Level 90 players will receive mythic shards and extremely rare red crystals in addition to the new runes! Red crystals are the only currency that you can spend on unique mythic boosters. 

[quote]Please note that if you reach level 90 during the events, the new stage of the event will begin, and your number of spins and Runic Scrolls will be reset. All current rewards will be saved and you will be able to take part in another event with even cooler rewards! In this case, you can contact our tech [url=https://nival.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]support[/url] and we will send you a compensation to make the start in the new event more pleasant and quick :)[/quote]
Events follow the familiar rules — spin the wheel of fortune for Runic Scrolls and get useful prizes! The more spins, the more rewards!

[h3]You can get Runic Scrolls:[/h3]
Via in-game methods (get [b]twice more Runic Scrolls[/b] by activating Premium):
[list]
[*] winning in battles; 
[*] completing the tasks;
[*] opening chests located on the map. 
[/list]

Via other ways:
[list]
[*] watching ads (on mobile devices);
[*] purchases with stars (now [b]1,5 times more[/b] spins at the same price – 3000 Runic Scrolls for 100 stars!).
[/list]

[quote]Events will last [b]until May 18[/b], but take note that:[list]
[*] [b]23:59 UTC May 17[/b] is the last minute you can get Runic Scrolls via in-game methods. Runic Scrolls you’ve already collected will be stored on your account for 24 hours.
[*] [b]Until 23:59 UTC May 18[/b], you will be able to use remaining Runic Scrolls to spin the wheel.
[*] After that, Runic Scrolls will disappear from your account.
[/list][/quote]
Let's get some of those new runes!

now [b]1,5 times more[/b] spins at the same price – 3000 Runic Scrolls for 100 stars!

notes.title: League PvP Rewards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0f68544b7eef212bae398f0497d7b2df9303410b.png[/img]

Dear friends!

The first PvP season in Defenders 2 is gradually coming to its end. This means, 100 best players will soon receive their rewards!

While rewards for classic PvP are quite clear — winners will get Defender's, Usurper's, and Conqueror's Chevrons — league rewards arouse some passionate interest among players! ;)

Today we are going to satisfy your curiosity and tell what trophies will be given to a hundred best warriors of the league PvP!

[quote][h3]Leader’s Cup[/h3]
This is a special award that grants new abilities to the victor. Increases rate of fire of all towers by 5%.
 
This card will be granted to players who take places from 100 to 11 in the global leaderboard.

[h3]Champion's Cup[/h3] 
Only the very best warriors are awarded the special power of the Champion's Cup. Increases rate of fire of all towers by 10%.
 
Only those skilled enough to take places from 4 to 10 in the global leaderboard will win this trophy.
 
[h3]Victor's Cup[/h3] 
Only the greatest warriors of the Prime Zone are honored with the Victor's Cup. Increases rate of fire of all towers by 15%.
 
Such a valuable reward can be won only by the most powerful players — three best warriors in the leaderboard![/quote]
Hurry up to make your way through the top 100 list — every minute, the season comes closer to its end!

notes.title: Hotfix coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/a49261bb467bc2fea59f7f9776b6b5394f7f5a34.png[/img]

Dear Players!

On April 3rd we released a patch that brought Seasons to the game.

As it has been the very first season launch, it is in many cases a “test season”. And at the moment we are working on two issues to implement them to the game ASAP.

First, as many of you have noticed, the rating clearance didn’t work as it was supposed to. Unfortunetely, in the “combat” conditions it implemented differently, than during the tests. We are already working on its fix together with the issue when you could recieve a negative rating (a substraction from your rating) after the battle.

The second issue looked well in design, but life put its corrections to it. There was an initial limit of the minimum players in the Mines to get rewards for it and thus to climb to the next leauge. But in fact it led to the unsatisfying situations when players couldn’t move up the league, although they fullfill alll the conditions for it.

We are already working on the hotfix with these two changes and will try to release it ASAP. Meanwhile we thank you for your patience and your support.

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/c69c9f757bb6c9e3320e6dd46d3156d8acb6182b.png[/img]

We are introducing the long-awaited system of seasons to Defenders 2! Take part in battles, fight your way up the leaderboard, and earn unique rewards: only 100 best players will receive special prizes! PvP rating will reset as the seasons start, meaning everybody will stand a chance to win!

Season rewards feature chevron cards that can be equipped in the slots for Heroes. These cards will grant special titles, visible to everybody in the chat, to the best players in the PvP competition! The season rewards will also give special bonuses to their owners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b0615ab31a076ce1b73e5fe7d4573c4748246ab0.png[/img]

We considerably reworked the league system.

Areas were changed: the red area is now intended for players with no victories, the blue, for players with at least one victory, and the green is for the best three players. Besides, rewards for the blue area were improved while less active players will find only 1 Silver in red chests.

To enter the next league, apart from getting into the green area, a player now also has to win a certain number of times. The change will prevent situations when participants accidentally got into too difficult leagues.

Moreover, the league can no longer drop and each mine has the highest possible league.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d450cfb8ea6200425689046cf067a70bd2c7f406.png[/img]

Having high-level players in mind, we are introducing the new league — Mythic League! Its rewards completely correspond to its status and name. Here you can earn valuable red crystals that can be exchanged for chests with mythic content in the shop.

Besides, Mythic League is not level-limited. Players below level 70 can enter it too! They just need to fulfill certain conditions.

Mythic League also has its own PvP rating that is determined by a player's position in all competitions together.

Learn more about the seasons, new league system, and Mythic League in this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/429540/view/3849954572245430667]announcement[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/c3f0535c19dc9022262b56987284177ca2fbe91f.png[/img]

We are announcing a course, set for a fight with abusing mechanics that destroy the desire to think over various combinations and strategies. This patch, we are adding two changes into the game.

We have reworked Ship Crane. From now on, HP of the base will always restore by 1❤ per minute and the number of additional lives will be limited: 1–5❤ per battle, depending on the Ship Crane upgrade. Because of this change, the annoying strategy of making the creeps circle round the battlefield will become considerably harder to perform. This is our first step towards a complete solution to this problem.

The Help me function (help from friends) was giving an unfair advantage to some players, allowing them to farm a variety of valuable rewards, which was damaging the in-game balance. As we introduce the system of seasons and rating reset, we want to remove such abuses and let all the players fight on equal terms, whether they have Facebook accounts or not. That is why we disabled the Help me function this patch. Right now we are reconsidering the system of social interactions. Our goal is to unbind the friends' bonuses from social networks.

As a part of balance changes, we reduced the number of available simultaneous battles on the map. Now, up to nine arenas can be available on default: three Assaults, three Hunts, and three Raids. Each mode has common, epic, and legendary difficulty. As before, timers appear on the map when a player wins arena battles. There can be nine of them too and they are selected as described above.

At the same time, we increased the highest upgrade level of Aeronautics from 6 to 10. This way, when the skill is fully upgraded, the number of available arenas (timers) is increased to 18.

Besides, since Duelist became much stronger in the new conditions, he is temporarily unavailable to get in Hero Packs or through level up. We are planning to rebalance the Hero and bring him back into the ranks later. Duelist will still be a part of your collection and grant the same effect if you already have the Hero card.

The effects of Beautification and Warlord were swapped. Now Beautification grants bonus experience when fusing any cards while Warlord affects Hero cards only.

Ship changes mentioned above are not the only ones. Now, all the upgrades are divided into four groups: common, special, rare, and epic. The higher the group, the more expensive the upgrade and the more time it takes to build it. Also, different upgrade groups become available at different account levels.

League rewards got rebalanced too. We revised the number of keys in green league chests: Stone and Bronze leagues now have 1 key each, Silver and Gold have 1-2, and Legendary and Mythic grant 1-3 keys. Blue chests always contain 1 key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/52980ba60fe8caf0ede3f6491bdce55f9cab89cb.png[/img]

Mythic chests in the shop are now available from level 90. From the very beginning, our goal was to create a new "red" type of content for high-level players who have already collected all the cards — so they could experience interesting fresh combos and new tactical horizons. However, — judging by our statistics and your feedback — mythic content has led to an issue: even legendary cards are getting irrelevant too fast and builds are no longer diverse. To fix this situation, we are making mythic content available at higher levels. Note: players of levels 70–89 who already have red cards won't lose anything. At the same time, they won't be able to get new mythic content from chests and events until they reach level 90.

We continue to work on the Defenders 2 interface to make the game more convenient for you, so this update brings some other pleasant changes to the shop!

Let's start with the most pleasant one  We fixed a bug, allowing players to get an unlimited number of stars for ads, so the Free Stars option is back in the shop in the mobile version of the game!

For your convenience, we moved the daily, weekly, and special offers to the main shop. Now, if you click the calendar icon on the global map, it will summon the list of rewards for entering the game.

Here is another small QoL change: we replaced packs with 4000, 8500 and 23,000 Silver by packs with 1000, 10,000 and 100,000 Silver. With such clear numbers, it will be much easier to do calculations in the head (in case you decide to buy several packs at a time). Yet, the exchange rate of Silver against Stars is the same: 1 Star = 100 Silver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ba29d1b60aa4dcaba68693f31b45e8b374af78a2.png[/img]

The shop interface was not the only interface improvement! The notification on the ship icon now shows only the number of currently available upgrades.

Also, the buttons of the ship and league battles are swapped. You can now see your season rating near the button of league battles.

The following change was made at your requests: the Skip animation option now applies to Hero Packs too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/368d6f265b8c8d5726c29366339f8f912d0a4e1b.png[/img]

Naturally, we introduced several fixes into the game too:[list]
[*] Swift Rune properly works on Stun Tower and Mermaid's Tower.
[*] A player gets back to the global map when the progress is restarted.
[*] Damage over time (DOT) now gets calculated correctly for the Poisonous Swamp spell.
[*] Fixed the description of Vixen and Premium account.
[/list]
